articles.titleTr: Coinbase’s US national trust bank charter takes effect
articles.summaryTr: Coinbase plans to expand its institutional crypto custody business under the federal charter and is exploring digital asset payment products.
articles.articleText: Coinbase’s US national trust bank charter takes effect Coinbase plans to expand its institutional crypto custody business under the federal charter and is exploring digital asset payment products. Coinbase’s national trust bank charter took effect on Friday, according to the US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC). The applied for the charter in October 2025 and received preliminary approval in April 2026, according to the OCC’s filing record. The charter allows Coinbase National Trust Company to hold digital assets on behalf of clients as a fiduciary, according to the OCC’s preliminary approval letter. Coinbase plans to offer institutional clients segregated custody accounts, with access to staking, financing and trading through other Coinbase entities, according to its charter application. Coinbase’s application also outlined plans to explore digital asset payment products and custody services that would allow clients to interact with select smart contracts. Other crypto companies that received OCC national trust bank charters include Ripple, Circle, BitGo, Fidelity Digital Assets and Paxos. Crypto.com and Stripe-owned Bridge received conditional approval, while Kraken and EDX Markets are still pursuing charters. Related: Hyperliquid Strategies seeks futures registration for perps

articles.articleText: Robinhood opens access to US IPOs for UK retail investors Robinhood’s UK customers can request shares in eligible US initial public offerings at the offer price before the stocks begin trading. Robinhood has launched a service that lets UK retail investors request shares in eligible US initial public offerings (IPOs) before trading begins. Customers can use their existing investment accounts to review offering documents in the app and request shares at the IPO price without paying trading commissions, Robinhood said Monday. Robinhood said it has participated in more than 50 IPOs since launching the service in the US in 2021. The company did not identify which upcoming US IPOs would be available to UK investors. Cointelegraph asked Robinhood for clarification but did not receive a response by publication. The expansion follows Robinhood’s third-quarter earnings report in October, when the company reported record revenue of $1.42 billion and net income of $476 million. Robinhood shares (HOOD) closed at $80.91 on Friday, gaining 3.2%, according to Yahoo Finance. The stock traded at $79.50 in premarket trading on Monday. Related: Robinhood’s Tenev warns US tokenization uncertainty deters ‘serious assets’

articles.title: At least 34 dead after Europe-bound migrant boat sinks off Senegal
articles.summary: The Atlantic crossing to Spain's Canary Islands remains dangerous for migrants seeking a better life
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: At least 34 dead after Europe-bound migrant boat sinks off Senegal
articles.summaryTr: The Atlantic crossing to Spain's Canary Islands remains dangerous for migrants seeking a better life
articles.articleText: At least 34 dead after Europe-bound migrant boat sinks off Senegal - Published At least 34 people have died after a boat carrying migrants sank off the coast of Senegal, the Senegalese Press Agency (APS) reports, citing an official source. The interior ministry said one person had been rescued, but the number of people still missing was yet to be established. The small wooden boat capsized between the capital, Dakar and the northern city of Saint-Louis, as it headed towards Spain's Canary Islands. Spanish migrant rights group Walking Borders recorded 635 deaths on the Atlantic route to the Canary Islands between January and May 2026, the highest toll among the routes it monitors. Saliou Diouf, founder of Senegalese migrant aid group Boza Fii, told AFP that all the bodies recovered so far were Senegalese. The nationalities of other people on board was yet to be established, as search operations continued. President Bassirou Diomaye Faye has expressed his condolences to the victims' families and urged Senegalese nationals not risk their lives on the dangerous sea crossings. In a statement posted on X, he pledged to intensify efforts to dismantle the networks organising the journeys. "We will relentlessly continue the fight against those who organise these crossings and the work that gives our young people reasons to hope here," he said. The tragedy comes amid renewed concerns over the dangers facing migrant attempting to reach Europe by sea. Walking Borders estimates that about 21 people died for every 100 who reached the Canary Islands during the period it monitored. Senegalese authorities said they had intercepted another boat, on Friday, carrying 142 migrants attempting to reach Spain. Those on board included 23 women, two babies and two other children. Police said the group comprised nationals of Senegal, Gambia, Guinea-Bissau, Guinea and Nigeria. Meanwhile, a state of emergency was declared on the Spanish island of El Hierro on Saturday following a surge in migrant arrivals. More than 3,300 people have reached the island in about 30 boats since the beginning of November, according to local authorities. This amounts to almost a third of the population on the island, one of the main entry points into Europe for migrants arriving from West Africa. Fernando Clavijo, president of the Canary Islands regional government, described the situation as "absolutely unsustainable," reports the Reuters news agency. The route has grown in prominence amid tighter controls and increased cooperation between European countries and North African states, which may have diverted some journeys away from the central Mediterranean. Limited employment opportunities, family pressures and established migration networks are among the factors driving people to leave Senegal, according to the International Organization for Migration (IOM). For many young people, the prospect of finding work and earning more abroad remains a powerful incentive, despite the risks of crossing the Atlantic in overcrowded boat. Nearly one in four young people in Senegal was unemployed in the second quarter of 2026, according to the country's statistics agency. The figure highlights the challenge facing President Faye's government as it seeks to create jobs for a predominantly young population that overwhelmingly voted for him in the 2024 elections. In a statement on Sunday, Senegal's interior ministry said it would continue efforts to combat people-smuggling networks, including by strengthening cooperation with neighbouring countries. articles.titleTr: Four killed in Gaza after sand embankment collapses onto tents, health ministry says
articles.summaryTr: Three children are among those killed in the incident that came a day after heavy rain reportedly flooded tens of thousands of tents across Gaza.
articles.articleText: Four killed in Gaza after sand embankment collapses onto tents, health ministry says - Published Three children and one woman were killed when a sand embankment collapsed onto tents in central Gaza following heavy rain, the Hamas-run health ministry says. Five injured people were also reportedly rescued after the incident on Sunday night at a camp for displaced families south of Deir al-Balah. Videos showed men using phone torches to search for survivors beneath boulders, sand and collapsed tents. The Civil Defence service, which operates under the Hamas-run interior ministry, said the "humanitarian tragedy" should prompt urgent action by international organisations to provide safe shelters for displaced people and move tents away from sandy areas, slopes and locations at risk of collapse. Torrential rain on Saturday reportedly flooded tens of thousands of tents across Gaza, leaving many Palestinians without a dry place to sleep. The Civil Defence said water levels reached up to 1.5m (4.9ft) in some places and that its first responders were able to respond to only 10% of the 2,100 distress calls they received. "Protecting the lives of displaced people is an urgent humanitarian responsibility. Their tents must not become death traps beneath sand and rainwater," it warned. - Tens of thousands of tents flooded after heavy rains in Gaza - Published1 day ago - Funding shortages force World Food Programme to cut Gaza aid - Published20 October The Civil Defence initially reported on Sunday that three children and two women were killed when the sand embankment collapsed. But the health ministry said on Monday morning that only one woman was among the dead. She was identified as Tahrir Nabhan, while the children were named as Mariam Nabhan and her brother Salah, and Habiba al-Zein. Mustafa al-Masri told the BBC that he and other rescuers had used their bare hands to dig the victims and survivors out of the sand and rubble. "It was extremely difficult. This mound was huge and wide. It collapsed onto the tent, and we didn't know what to do," he said. "When we got here, we, along with the young men from the camp, pulled them out with our own hands. We pulled out the children and the woman." "Their father arrived shouting, 'My children, my children, my children, my children.' We pulled his children out, put them in the ambulance, and took them to the hospital." Masri added that he had been displaced from the northern town of Beit Hanoun but had stayed in central Gaza because there was "nowhere for me to return to". "We went out looking around, searching through the open areas and hills, but I couldn't find any place other than this area that felt suitable for me." The International Organization for Migration's regional crisis co-ordinator, Karl Baker, told the BBC from Gaza that the territory's 2.1 million population was confined to only 30% of its total area and that many people were "unfortunately living in areas which would not be normal if we were not in this time of conflict". He said the UN agency and its partners were trying to make sure there were enough tents and tarpaulins, as well as improved drainage in camps, to help them get through the winter. However, he warned that aid currently getting into Gaza was not sufficient to meet the demands of the population, describing it as "the very smallest of Band-Aids [plasters]". "We need more support, in-kind donations. We need funding in order to help the communities to help themselves," he said. "We need a lot more to happen." UN agencies have called on Israeli authorities to allow in the specialist equipment and materials required to improve living conditions for displaced families. Cogat, the Israeli military body tasked with co-ordinating deliveries, said on Sunday that more than 91,000 tents, 12 vacuum trucks for waste removal, and fuel and engine oil for pumping facilities have been delivered since the start of the "Gaza Winterization Plan". But it added that Israel would not permit the entry of equipment that could be used for military purposes by Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups. An estimated 80% of all structures in Gaza have been destroyed or damaged during the war between Israel and Hamas, according to the UN. More than 1.9 million people have been displaced, many of them multiple times, and 1.2 million of them are currently living in tents or makeshift shelters, it says. The UN has warned that the humanitarian situation in Gaza remains dire despite the ceasefire agreed in October 2025, as Israeli air strikes and other attacks continue to hit populated areas, causing casualties and property damage and driving further displacement. The Gaza war was triggered by the Hamas-led attack on southern Israel on 7 October 2023, when about 1,200 people were killed and 251 others were taken hostage. Since then, more than 74,640 people have been killed in Gaza, according to the territory's health ministry, whose figures are considered reliable by the UN. Additional reporting by Malak Hassouneh

articles.title: Trump says he was 'kidding' about Dana White press secretary offer
articles.summary: The president told the Ultimate Fighting Championship boss to "please take the job" in a Truth Social post on Saturday.

articles.titleTr: Trump says he was 'kidding' about Dana White press secretary offer
articles.summaryTr: The president told the Ultimate Fighting Championship boss to "please take the job" in a Truth Social post on Saturday.
articles.articleText: Trump says he was 'kidding' about Dana White press secretary offer - Published US President Donald Trump has said he "was kidding" about asking Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) boss Dana White to be the White House press secretary. Trump told the media on Sunday that White "loves the idea" but that the invitation was "just a little fun". It comes after the president posted on his Truth Social platform on Saturday that he had offered White the role, asking him to take it while writing, "Dana will be a Press Secretary like none other." White said later that day he was going to meet the president on Monday, but would not be drawn into whether or not he would take the vacant position. On Sunday Trump told reporters White was visiting him on Monday for "other reasons". "I think he's going to be in Washington. So he's going to come over and see me. "I will tell you, I was only kidding. But Dana loves the idea. And there's only one Dana. He's great," the president said. "But, it was it was just a little fun." The press secretary role is yet to be filled after it became vacant in October when Katie Zacharia quit after less than five days in the job. She took over from Karoline Leavitt, who was the youngest press secretary in US history and had held the role since Trump began his second term. Trump's job offer came after a heavy loss in the midterm elections, where the Republican Party lost its majority in both houses of Congress. In his Truth Social post on Saturday, he said he was "pleased to announce" that White "has been offered the job". He said he had asked White to bring with him several current and former mixed martial arts fighters as "assistants". "We need these people to defend us against the Lunatic Left," he wrote. "Dana, please take the job!" Asked about the Trump offer at a news conference on Saturday, the UFC chief executive said he had "lot of jobs already". "I'm sure we'll have something to talk about after that," he said of their planned Monday meeting, but did not say whether or not he would take the job. White leads UFC, and PowerSlap, a regulated slap-fighting promotion league, as well as recently launching promotion company Zuffa Boxing. He is also a board member of Meta, the owner of Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp. White appeared as a speaker in support of Trump's White House campaigns at the Republican National Conventions in 2016, 2020 and 2024. He also appeared on stage for Trump's victory speech in the 2024 presidential election. This summer, the UFC staged a cage match on the White House lawn.

articles.title: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's affair with suspected Chinese spy
articles.summary: Jensen Huang also admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and says he will cooperate with a security investigation.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's affair with suspected Chinese spy
articles.summaryTr: Jensen Huang also admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and says he will cooperate with a security investigation.
articles.articleText: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's affair with suspected Chinese spy - Published US tech giant Nvidia has opened an independent investigation following reports its CEO Jensen Huang had a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. Nvidia, one of the most valuable companies in the world, said its board had no reason to believe the company's secrets or national security were compromised, adding that the CEO was committed to continuing to lead the organisation. Separately, Jensen Huang admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. US intelligence officials believed that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report., external Jensen Huang said he took "full responsibility" for what he did, adding that he had fallen short of his responsibilities to Nvidia's employees, board and shareholders. Nvidia is one of the world's largest companies and seen as central to making the hardware for emerging AI technologies, and Jensen Huang has been in charge of it for more than 30 years. He said: "I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry." His statement continued: "Regarding the national security concerns raised in news reports, Nvidia's Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation. I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. "I love our country and our company. I am committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America's national security. I am proud and grateful to be an American." A separate statement issued by Nvidia's board of directors said it would begin an investigation in "light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort". It continued: "The Board prioritises US national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of Nvidia and its shareholders. "While the Board has no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, the Board's inquiry will examine all available information." US President Donald Trump said he had not spoken to the Nvidia boss since news of the investigation emerged. "I just know he's a fine person, but you never know what's going on," Trump told reporters, adding that he had "done an amazing job for our country". The New York Times reported in late October that Trump had been briefed last year on intelligence alleging Alice Huang was spying on China's behalf. Asked by reporters on Sunday whether he now wished he had "acted on the intelligence" at the time, Trump responded: "No, I don't think so. I think he's an honourable guy." Secretary of State Marco Rubio, meanwhile, refused to comment when asked about Huang before flying to Paris for a meeting of the G7. Rubio told the press: "I can't comment on any of that. I just can't comment because of the nature of it. And I also can't comment on an internal corporate matter that's going on with Nvidia, as you highlight, I don't know anything about that part of it so." Last spring, the secretary of state reportedly oversaw the drafting of a memo that warned the Trump administration about Huang's relationship with the Chinese businesswoman, according to the New York Times. China has previously rejected allegations of an espionage operation targeting the Nvidia chief, describing the claims as "groundless speculation". Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun told reporters at a daily press briefing: "We have already responded to this. The allegations about Chinese spies are entirely groundless, speculative and intended to smear and malign China." Jensen Huang rescued Nvidia from bankruptcy on more than one occasion, and he took risks on AI a long time before the rest of the world did. His decision to make Nvidia chips, originally designed for gaming, become the best in the business for AI development, has now paid off in spades and the company is worth trillions. This is a big blow for a man who is renowned for being a workaholic, a perfectionist and someone who expects incredibly high standards from his staff. Alice Huang, who is of no relation to Jensen Huang, is linked to Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed. The company told the New York Times last month its current leadership took the allegations seriously and had appointed external legal advisers to conduct an internal investigation. Nvidia is a central player in AI infrastructure, providing chips to leading AI model developers including OpenAI and Meta. The microchip manufacturer is worth some $4.5 trillion, making it one of the most valuable companies ever. US intelligence agencies had been monitoring Alice Huang and concluded that she was acting on behalf of the Chinese government, according to unnamed sources cited by the New York Times. Surveillance reportedly revealed communications between Alice Huang and an American citizen, who was subsequently identified as Jensen Huang through a process known as "unmasking". It remains unclear what information Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly passed to Beijing, how valuable it was, or when she is believed to have begun gathering intelligence. Alice Huang did not respond to the paper's request for comment. Last week, members of Congress wrote to Jensen Huang, asking him to appear before them in the light of the reported relationship. Three House Republican committee leaders asked the CEO to appear later in the month, to talk about Nvidia's "security protocols against foreign adversary espionage" given his reported relationship with Alice Huang. "Recent reports raise significant national security concerns regarding the PRC's [China's] access to sensitive US technology and information. "The issue of PRC infiltration and access to cutting-edge US technology is core to the investigative work of our three committees this Congress," the letter said. Nvidia's AI chips have been a major focus of the rivalry between the US and China, and Washington has previously imposed controls on where its advanced products can be sold. The H200, Nvidia's second most advanced semiconductor, had previously been restricted by Washington over concerns that it would give China's technology industry an edge over the US. In January, the Trump administration said it would allow the company to sell its H200 chips to Chinese customers under certain conditions. articles.articleText: Hut owner wins battle to keep living in off-grid home he built - Published An off-grid hut that produces its own heating and electricity can continue to be the home of the man who built it, a council has decided. Geoffrey Finnimore, a self-employed architectural designer, erected the structure in Glandwr, near Crymych, in 2020, but never told authorities or asked for permission. Pembrokeshire council told him he must apply for retrospective permission for the home that is self-sufficient, and also collects rain water. However, the local authority found that because it has now been occupied as a home for more than four years, it is immune from prosecution action. "Without my home, which I created to solve my own problems and without state assistance, having to pay for other accommodation would be catastrophic for my finances and wellbeing," Finnimore said. The council asked him to apply for a lawful development certificate, external for the property. This is a formal legal document confirming the development is lawful. But as he had lived there for more than four years, it meant he could not be prosecuted, so his application was accepted, the Local Democracy Reporting Service said. Finnimore has been the principal custodian of 4.5 acres of land at Coed Troednoeth, Tir y Gafel since the previous owner left in 2018. They had lived at the site in a campervan with a lean-to structure, according to the council. But Finnimore described this as "less than adequate" for his health and wellbeing, so started developing the hut. In a personal statement to the local authority, he confirmed he had lived at the site for more than 10 years, earns less than £10,000 a year as a self-employed worker, and provided evidence of his long-term residency. He added: "This application has been sought by the council, and I have had to comply out of a position of vulnerability with respect to the prospect of enforcement against a building and living situation that has been demonstrated to be well-established and that I hold is deemed lawful. "In the context of a housing and a cost-of-living crisis I have taken care of my own needs. "So far as the council's responsibilities in that context goes, I see that as one less problem to solve. "Conversely, I would consider a rejection of a well-justified application like this as a contribution that exacerbates these deep and present social concerns." Council officers granted the certificate because they found, on the balance of probabilities, that Coed Troednoeth had existed and been occupied as a home for more than four years before the application, making it immune from enforcement action. It added: "In June 2020, the land was purchased by Mr Finnimore and in November 2020, he began using the building as his principal dwelling, hence the justification to apply for a certificate of lawful use." articles.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

articles.articleText: Release Number 9322-26 CFTC Staff Addresses Use of Trust Companies for Daily Settlements November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission’s Division of Clearing and Risk today issued a no-action letter addressing whether derivatives clearing organizations may use trust companies to conduct daily settlements with clearing members. According to the letter, a derivatives clearing organization may use a trust company for daily settlements if it treats the trust company as it would a settlement bank under applicable CFTC requirements. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

articles.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
articles.articleText: Release Number 9316-26 CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig announced the CFTC’s plan to increase the publication frequency of the Commitments of Traders Report (COT Report) from once to twice a week by the end of 2026. Data from Monday will be published on Wednesday, and data from Wednesday will be published on Friday. Both reports will be released at 3:30 p.m. ET on their respective publication days. Under the enhanced publication schedule, the reports’ latency will decrease from three days to two days. The change follows the Commission’s recent Request for Comment and reflects its commitment to providing market participants with more timely information about trading positions and activity in agricultural markets. The CFTC’s Division of Data is leading the effort to operationalize the expanded publication schedule through modernization and automation while maintaining accuracy. “COT Reports have been an important source of transparency for decades. Following feedback from the agricultural community, I’m pleased to announce the CFTC will be rolling out COT Reports twice a week to ensure this information stream is as useful as possible,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. -CFTC-

Selig announced the CFTC’s plan to increase the publication frequency of the Commitments of Traders Report (COT Report) from once to twice a week by the end of 2026. Data from Monday will be published on Wednesday, and data from Wednesday will be published on Friday. Both reports will be released at 3:30 p.m. ET on their respective publication days. Under the enhanced publication schedule, the reports’ latency will decrease from three days to two days. The change follows the Commission’s recent Request for Comment and reflects its commitment to providing market participants with more timely information about trading positions and activity in agricultural markets. The CFTC’s Division of Data is leading the effort to operationalize the expanded publication schedule through modernization and automation while maintaining accuracy. “COT Reports have been an important source of transparency for decades. Following feedback from the agricultural community, I’m pleased to announce the CFTC will be rolling out COT Reports twice a week to ensure this information stream is as useful as possible,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction
articles.articleText: Release Number 9315-26 CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced today it has filed a lawsuit against Utah to block the state’s efforts to shut down CFTC-registered contract markets using state laws. The lawsuit follows Utah’s decision to file civil enforcement actions in state court against CFTC-regulated markets and other businesses. Utah’s effort to restrict the functioning of CFTC-registered exchanges obstructs Congress’s decision to federally preempt state law. “Utah seeks to shut down prediction markets across a wide variety of markets,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Event contracts do not just serve hedging and investment purposes—they also provide the public with information about the outcome of future events. Congress entrusted the CFTC to be the federal regulator with sole responsibility to oversee these markets. As I’ve said before, the CFTC has the expertise and responsibility to defend its exclusive jurisdiction over commodity derivatives, and that’s exactly what we’ll do.” This action reflects the CFTC’s firm commitment to maintaining its exclusive jurisdiction over CFTC-registered prediction markets. The CFTC continues to draw a clear line: if a state challenges the lawful operation of a derivatives exchange, the Commission will protect federal sovereign interests. The Commission has also initiated legal proceedings against nine other states and has submitted briefs in four federal courts of appeal and one state supreme court. -CFTC-

news.articleText: Fon soruşturmasında yeni gelişme: Lydia Holding Başkanı Enver Çevik gözaltına alındı YAYIN TARİHİ, 09 Kasım 2026 16:41 PAYLAŞ - Sermaye piyasalarındaki işlemlere ilişkin yürütülen fon soruşturması kapsamında Lydia Holding Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Enver Çevik gözaltına alındı. Soruşturmada BDDK Başkan Yardımcısı Muhammet Erişen ile Adil Katılım Bankası Genel Müdürü Murat Yönaç'ın tutuklanmasına karar verilmişti. Sermaye piyasalarında gerçekleştirilen işlemlere ilişkin yürütülen fon soruşturması kapsamında Lydia Holding Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Enver Çevik gözaltına alındı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığınca sermaye piyasalarında gerçekleştirilen işlemlere ilişkin fon soruşturması devam ediyor. Lydia Holding Başkanı gözaltına alındı Soruşturma kapsamında gözaltına alınan Çevik, işlemleri için emniyete götürüldü. Gözaltına alınan diğer şüpheliler eski Takasbank Genel Müdürü Yunus Arıncı, Bulls Yatırım Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Kemal Akkaya ile Ruzy Madencilik Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Nureddin Çevik'in de emniyetteki işlemleri sürüyor. Öte yandan BDDK Başkan Yardımcısı Muhammet Erişen ile Adil Katılım Bankası Genel Müdürü Murat Yönaç'ın ise bu soruşturmada bugün tutuklanmasına karar verilmişti. Kaynak: AA

news.title: Koç Holding'den 2040 hedefi: Tatlı su kullanımını yüzde 85 azaltacak
news.summary: Koç Holding CEO'su Levent Çakıroğlu, topluluğun Türkiye'deki operasyonlarında 2040'a kadar tatlı su çekimini yüzde 85 azaltmayı hedeflediğini açıkladı.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Koç Holding'den 2040 hedefi: Tatlı su kullanımını yüzde 85 azaltacak
news.summaryTr: Koç Holding CEO'su Levent Çakıroğlu, topluluğun Türkiye'deki operasyonlarında 2040'a kadar tatlı su çekimini yüzde 85 azaltmayı hedeflediğini açıkladı.
news.articleText: Koç Holding'den 2040 hedefi: Tatlı su kullanımını yüzde 85 azaltacak - Koç Holding CEO'su Levent Çakıroğlu, topluluğun Türkiye'deki operasyonlarında 2040'a kadar tatlı su çekimini yüzde 85 azaltmayı hedeflediğini açıkladı. - Antalya COP31 Alanı'nda CNBC-e Genel Yayın Yönetmeni Servet Yıldırım'ın sorularını yanıtlayan Çakıroğlu, küresel ısınma ve iklim değişikliği risklerini yönetebilen şirketlerin rekabetçiliklerini koruyabileceğini ifade etti. Koç Holding CEO'su Levent Çakıroğlu, yeşil dönüşüm ve sürdürülebilirlik çalışmalarının şirketin stratejisinde önemli bir yer tuttuğunu belirterek, iklim değişikliğini gerçek bir iş riski olarak gördüklerini söyledi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Antalya COP31 Alanı'nda CNBC-e Genel Yayın Yönetmeni Servet Yıldırım'ın sorularını yanıtlayan Çakıroğlu, küresel ısınma ve iklim değişikliği risklerini yönetebilen şirketlerin rekabetçiliklerini koruyabileceğini ifade etti. Bu alanda tehditlerin yanı sıra fırsatların da bulunduğuna işaret eden Çakıroğlu, söz konusu riskleri fark eden, gerekli teknolojileri geliştiren ve inovasyona yatırım yapan şirketlerin rekabette öne çıkabileceğini kaydetti. "Verimlilik maliyet yapımızı daha rekabetçi hale getiriyor" Yeşil dönüşümün yatırımlara ve iş modellerine etkisine ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulunan Çakıroğlu, konuyu birkaç boyutta ele aldıklarını belirtti. Çakıroğlu, şunları söyledi: "En başta kendi süreçlerimizdeki verimliliği artıracak şekilde bunu değerlendiriyoruz. Kullanılan tüm kaynaklarda, enerjide de suda da sağladığımız her verimlilik maliyet yapımızı daha rekabetçi hale getiriyor. İkincisi ürünler açısından baktığımızda, bir taraftan regülasyonlar var. Avrupa bizim en büyük pazarımız. Avrupa Birliği bu konuda en önde hareket eden yapılardan birisi. Dolayısıyla hem otomotivde hem beyaz eşyada bu regülasyonlara uyma zorunluluğumuz da var. Ama bizim için daha önemlisi enerji verimliliğinde, su verimliliğinde öne çıkarak rekabette ayrışacak ürünleri de ortaya koyabilmek. Dolayısıyla bütün bu konuyu oldukça gerçekçi bir yaklaşımla ele alıyoruz." 2040'a kadar tatlı su çekimini yüzde 85 azaltacak Koç Holding'in 2040 yılına kadar operasyonlarında tatlı su çekimini yüzde 85 azaltma hedefini değerlendiren Çakıroğlu, hedefin Türkiye'deki faaliyetleri kapsadığını bildirdi. Türkiye'nin su stresi altında bulunan ülkelerden biri olduğuna dikkati çeken Çakıroğlu, su verimliliği konusunda tüm paydaşların birlikte hareket etmesi gerektiğini vurguladı. Çakıroğlu, Koç Topluluğu'nun geniş etki alanı ve gücü nedeniyle bu konuda liderlik etme sorumluluğuyla hareket ettiğini ifade etti. Yüzde 85'lik hedefin nasıl belirlendiğine ilişkin bilgi veren Çakıroğlu, şöyle konuştu: "Bizim portföyümüzdeki şirketlerimizin her birinin faaliyet konuları itibarıyla karşı karşıya kaldıkları su stresi, bununla ilgili çözüm yöntemleri birbirinden farklılık gösterebiliyor. Bütün bunları dikkate alarak şirketlerimiz kendi hedeflerini belirlediler. Biz Koç Holding'te vizyonu belirliyoruz. İddialı hedefler koymalarını istiyoruz arkadaşlardan, bir yön veriyoruz. Ama yol haritasını, hedeflerini her bir şirketimiz, bu şirketlerin yöneticileri olan arkadaşlar ortaya koyuyorlar. Yüzde 85, şirketlerimizin hedeflerinin bir birleşimi. Bunu yaparken de şu ana kadar aldığımız mesafeden cesaret alıyoruz. Son 3 yılda tatlı su çekimimizi yüzde 17 azalttık. Bunu yaparken bir taraftan da faaliyetlerimizde kullandığımız suyun yüzde 64'ünü ya yeniden kullanıyoruz ya da geri dönüştürüyoruz. Dolayısıyla bu tecrübeleri grup geneline yayma avantajına da sahibiz." Çakıroğlu, yüzde 85'lik azaltım hedefinin Türkiye'deki faaliyetleri kapsadığını, yurt dışındaki operasyonlarda da su çekimini azaltmaya yönelik benzer yöntemler uyguladıklarını kaydetti. "Tüpraş'ta su geri kazanım oranı yüzde 80'e ulaştı" Topluluk şirketlerinde yürütülen çalışmalara ilişkin örnekler de veren Çakıroğlu, enerji sektörünün fazla su kullanan alanlardan biri olduğunu, bu nedenle Tüpraş'ın çalışmalarının önem taşıdığını söyledi. Tüpraş'ın su geri kazanımı konusunda yüzde 80'lik orana ulaştığını belirten Çakıroğlu, şu değerlendirmelerde bulundu: "Tüpraş şirketimiz bugün itibarıyla baktığımızda suyun geri kazanımı konusunda yüzde 80'lik bir orana ulaştı ki bu çok yüksek bir oran. Bunu nasıl yaptı? Proseslerinde kullandığı suyu tekrar kullandı. Bir de belediyeden aldığı gri suyu arıtarak proseslerde kullanmak suretiyle bunu başardı. 2040 yılına geldiğimizde Tüpraş'ın hedefi geri kazanım oranını yüzde 98'e çıkarmak. Gerçekten büyük bir oran ve bunu yaptığınız zaman Tüpraş'ın büyüklüğünü dikkate aldığınızda çok büyük bir hacimden bahsediyoruz." Otomotiv ve beyaz eşya sektörlerinde de üretilen ürün başına kullanılan ve çekilen su miktarını azaltmaya odaklandıklarını aktaran Çakıroğlu, Ford Otosan'ın Yeniköy fabrikasında 2025 yılında tatlı su çekiminin yüzde 80 azaltıldığını bildirdi. Çakıroğlu, bu sonucun gri suyun arıtılarak yeniden kullanılmasıyla elde edildiğini belirtti. "Su güvenliği üretimin devamlılığı açısından önemli" Su verimliliği projelerinin yatırım maliyetleri ve finansal geri dönüşlerine ilişkin soruyu da yanıtlayan Çakıroğlu, projelerin fizibilitelerinin yapıldığını ve yatırımın geri dönüşünün değerlendirildiğini söyledi. Ancak konunun yalnızca finansal geri dönüş üzerinden ele alınamayacağını vurgulayan Çakıroğlu, şunları kaydetti: "Hepsinin tabii ki fizibilitesi yapılıyor. Bir taraftan geri dönüşüne bakıyoruz ama diğer taraftan şunun farkında olmamız lazım. Kuraklıklar artık çok uzun süre devam ediyor. Aşırı hava olaylarının etkilerini daha sık görüyoruz. Bu bir taraftan bizim için su güvenliğiyle ilgili bir karar. Suyu güvenli bir şekilde temin edemezsek üretim tesislerimizde bunun üretim üzerinde, şirketlerin büyümesi üzerinde ve hatta maliyeti üzerinde çok menfi etki etme potansiyeli var. Dolayısıyla fizibilitenin iki boyutunu birden dikkate almamız gerekiyor." "Yeni bir stratejik yatırım gündemimizde yok" Koç Holding'in gelecek dönemde yeşil dönüşüm kapsamında özellikle enerji ve otomotiv alanlarında yeni yatırımlar veya stratejik ortaklıklar yapıp yapmayacağına ilişkin soruyu da yanıtlayan Çakıroğlu, teknoloji ve inovasyon alanlarında işbirliklerine açık olduklarını belirtti. Çakıroğlu, dijital ve yeşil dönüşümün öncelikli alanlar arasında yer aldığını ifade ederek, şu açıklamayı yaptı: "Yeni yatırımlar konusunda özellikle teknoloji, inovasyon alanlarında işbirliklerini yapma konusunda çok istekliyiz. Burada hem dijital dönüşüm hem de yeşil dönüşüm öne çıkan konular arasında. Ama bununla ilgili yeni bir stratejik yatırım gündemimizde, paylaşılabilecek düzeyde bir konu değil. Öyle bir konu yok gündemimizde. Öyle olduğunda zaten bunlar halka açık şirketler biliyorsunuz, paylaşırız." Çakıroğlu, şirketlerin bu projeleri açıklayarak uygulamaya geçirmesinin küresel ölçekteki dönüşüm çabalarının önemli bir parçası olduğunu belirtti.

Yüzde 85'lik hedefin nasıl belirlendiğine ilişkin bilgi veren Çakıroğlu, şöyle konuştu: "Bizim portföyümüzdeki şirketlerimizin her birinin faaliyet konuları itibarıyla karşı karşıya kaldıkları su stresi, bununla ilgili çözüm yöntemleri birbirinden farklılık gösterebiliyor. Bütün bunları dikkate alarak şirketlerimiz kendi hedeflerini belirlediler. Biz Koç Holding'te vizyonu belirliyoruz. İddialı hedefler koymalarını istiyoruz arkadaşlardan, bir yön veriyoruz. Ama yol haritasını, hedeflerini her bir şirketimiz, bu şirketlerin yöneticileri olan arkadaşlar ortaya koyuyorlar. Yüzde 85, şirketlerimizin hedeflerinin bir birleşimi. Bunu yaparken de şu ana kadar aldığımız mesafeden cesaret alıyoruz. Son 3 yılda tatlı su çekimimizi yüzde 17 azalttık. Bunu yaparken bir taraftan da faaliyetlerimizde kullandığımız suyun yüzde 64'ünü ya yeniden kullanıyoruz ya da geri dönüştürüyoruz. Dolayısıyla bu tecrübeleri grup geneline yayma avantajına da sahibiz." Çakıroğlu, yüzde 85'lik azaltım hedefinin Türkiye'deki faaliyetleri kapsadığını, yurt dışındaki operasyonlarda da su çekimini azaltmaya yönelik benzer yöntemler uyguladıklarını kaydetti. "Tüpraş'ta su geri kazanım oranı yüzde 80'e ulaştı" Topluluk şirketlerinde yürütülen çalışmalara ilişkin örnekler de veren Çakıroğlu, enerji sektörünün fazla su kullanan alanlardan biri olduğunu, bu nedenle Tüpraş'ın çalışmalarının önem taşıdığını söyledi. Tüpraş'ın su geri kazanımı konusunda yüzde 80'lik orana ulaştığını belirten Çakıroğlu, şu değerlendirmelerde bulundu: "Tüpraş şirketimiz bugün itibarıyla baktığımızda suyun geri kazanımı konusunda yüzde 80'lik bir orana ulaştı ki bu çok yüksek bir oran. Bunu nasıl yaptı? Proseslerinde kullandığı suyu tekrar kullandı. Bir de belediyeden aldığı gri suyu arıtarak proseslerde kullanmak suretiyle bunu başardı. 2040 yılına geldiğimizde Tüpraş'ın hedefi geri kazanım oranını yüzde 98'e çıkarmak. Gerçekten büyük bir oran ve bunu yaptığınız zaman Tüpraş'ın büyüklüğünü dikkate aldığınızda çok büyük bir hacimden bahsediyoruz." Otomotiv ve beyaz eşya sektörlerinde de üretilen ürün başına kullanılan ve çekilen su miktarını azaltmaya odaklandıklarını aktaran Çakıroğlu, Ford Otosan'ın Yeniköy fabrikasında 2025 yılında tatlı su çekiminin yüzde 80 azaltıldığını bildirdi. Çakıroğlu, bu sonucun gri suyun arıtılarak yeniden kullanılmasıyla elde edildiğini belirtti. "Su güvenliği üretimin devamlılığı açısından önemli" Su verimliliği projelerinin yatırım maliyetleri ve finansal geri dönüşlerine ilişkin soruyu da yanıtlayan Çakıroğlu, projelerin fizibilitelerinin yapıldığını ve yatırımın geri dönüşünün değerlendirildiğini söyledi. Ancak konunun yalnızca finansal geri dönüş üzerinden ele alınamayacağını vurgulayan Çakıroğlu, şunları kaydetti: "Hepsinin tabii ki fizibilitesi yapılıyor. Bir taraftan geri dönüşüne bakıyoruz ama diğer taraftan şunun farkında olmamız lazım. Kuraklıklar artık çok uzun süre devam ediyor. Aşırı hava olaylarının etkilerini daha sık görüyoruz. Bu bir taraftan bizim için su güvenliğiyle ilgili bir karar. Suyu güvenli bir şekilde temin edemezsek üretim tesislerimizde bunun üretim üzerinde, şirketlerin büyümesi üzerinde ve hatta maliyeti üzerinde çok menfi etki etme potansiyeli var. Dolayısıyla fizibilitenin iki boyutunu birden dikkate almamız gerekiyor." "Yeni bir stratejik yatırım gündemimizde yok" Koç Holding'in gelecek dönemde yeşil dönüşüm kapsamında özellikle enerji ve otomotiv alanlarında yeni yatırımlar veya stratejik ortaklıklar yapıp yapmayacağına ilişkin soruyu da yanıtlayan Çakıroğlu, teknoloji ve inovasyon alanlarında işbirliklerine açık olduklarını belirtti. Çakıroğlu, dijital ve yeşil dönüşümün öncelikli alanlar arasında yer aldığını ifade ederek, şu açıklamayı yaptı: "Yeni yatırımlar konusunda özellikle teknoloji, inovasyon alanlarında işbirliklerini yapma konusunda çok istekliyiz. Burada hem dijital dönüşüm hem de yeşil dönüşüm öne çıkan konular arasında. Ama bununla ilgili yeni bir stratejik yatırım gündemimizde, paylaşılabilecek düzeyde bir konu değil. Öyle bir konu yok gündemimizde. Öyle olduğunda zaten bunlar halka açık şirketler biliyorsunuz, paylaşırız." Çakıroğlu, şirketlerin bu projeleri açıklayarak uygulamaya geçirmesinin küresel ölçekteki dönüşüm çabalarının önemli bir parçası olduğunu belirtti.

news.titleTr: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summaryTr: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
news.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto, the European Union called on the finance industry to write a common rulebook for tokenized securities, Zcash developers seek another reduction in block times and Binance France is closing up shop in the country. EU taps industry to set standards for tokenized securities The European Central Bank, European Commission and European Securities and Markets Authority are seeking nominations for an industry-led group that will draft common standards for holding and settling tokenized securities. Eligible applicants include EU industry associations, global institutions, private firms and fintech companies. They can apply to the European Tokenisation Standards Group (ETSG) by Nov. 27, with work set to begin in January 2027, according to a release published Monday. The three EU institutions will participate as observers. The group will develop technical and market standards to help companies hold and settle tokenized securities across different distributed ledger technology (DLT) platforms and ensure those platforms can work with existing financial systems. The group aims to produce an initial set of standards by early 2028, according to its mandate. The standards will support Appia, the Eurosystem’s initiative to develop a blueprint for Europe’s tokenized financial markets. The institutions warned that fragmentation could limit the benefits of tokenization and said the group may recommend ways for EU authorities to encourage firms to adopt its standards. In September, the Eurosystem launched Pontes, a system that allows financial institutions to settle wholesale transactions in tokenized assets in central bank money. Zcash devs propose another block time cut days after NU7 upgrade Zcash developers have proposed reducing the blockchain’s target block interval from 25 seconds to 20 seconds, seeking faster transaction confirmations days after activating the NU7 upgrade. On Sunday, developers ValarDragon and Evan Forbes submitted a draft Zcash Improvement Proposal (ZIP) on GitHub, saying that they want the change to be included in the next community poll and considered for the upcoming NU7.1 network upgrade. The reduction would shorten the expected wait for initial transaction confirmations. According to the proposal, this would improve the user experience for point-of-sale payments, exchange deposits and cross-chain swaps. The developers said the change would not increase the network’s overall daily capacity for private transactions. The proposal would also preserve Zcash’s existing issuance schedule, despite blocks being produced more frequently. The proposal comes just days after Zcash’s NU7 upgrade went live. On Friday, the NU7 upgrade was activated on the mainnet, cutting the network’s target block interval from 75 seconds to 25 seconds. The upgrade also introduced a Network Sustainability Mechanism designed to recycle a portion of transaction fees into future mining rewards while preserving Zcash’s 21 million ZEC supply cap. Binance France emails announce closure of accounts Dec. 31 Binance France is closing up shop in the country. Customers have been notified by email during early November, according to media reports. All accounts will be closed on Dec. 31, and any assets left on the exchange will be charged monthly fees starting on Nov. 29, Cryptoast, Crypto Briefing and other media reported on Saturday, citing emails sent to users by Binance. On that date, accounts still maintaining a balance will pay a monthly maintenance fee of 0.025% of the balance, or a minimum of 10 USDC, a stablecoin tracking the US dollar. To avoid fees, withdrawals must be completed by Nov. 29, the exchange said.

news.title: The $2.85B Binance hackers lost shows why the UK needs stablecoin freeze rules
news.summary: The Binance hack proved stablecoin freezes work. Now the UK should make clear freeze rules a condition of listing coins.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: The $2.85B Binance hackers lost shows why the UK needs stablecoin freeze rules
news.summaryTr: The Binance hack proved stablecoin freezes work. Now the UK should make clear freeze rules a condition of listing coins.
news.articleText: The $2.85B Binance hackers lost shows why the UK needs stablecoin freeze rules The Binance hack proved stablecoin freezes work. Now the UK should make clear freeze rules a condition of listing coins. Opinion by Lissele Pratt, co-founder, Capitalixe Last weekend, the Federal Bureau of Investigation claimed that North Korea was behind the $6.3 billion Binance hack, which analysts are calling the largest heist on record. While I’ve read a lot about the scale of this heist, far less has been said about what went right. Because while it is true that the perpetrators stole $6.3 billion, they haven’t actually been able to hold on to a significant proportion of those takings. $2.85 billion of the funds has been frozen. The reason for this comes down to what the stolen money was comprised of. Of that $2.85 billion, 94% was held in stablecoins. While this hack was terrible news all around, it did show that centralized control, oftentimes criticized by crypto purists, might actually be one of the strongest tools we have against crypto crime. Because, unlike other assets, stablecoins can be frozen by their issuers, giving victims a real chance to stop stolen money reaching the wrong hands. It does, however, raise an uncomfortable question. If private companies have the power to freeze billions of dollars in assets, who decides when they should be allowed to use it? The United Kingdom now has the opportunity to do just that. The race to get rid of stablecoins To get an idea of just how much the freeze mattered, you just have to look at what the hackers did within the first hour of their heist. Related: Binance, Polymarket seek Polygon hard fork to recover $6.8M in stolen crypto Clearly, they understood that there was a very limited window to move the stablecoins before anyone could stop them. So that’s exactly what they did. What was frozen from the Binance hack. Source: Elliptic Less than an hour after the hack began, they had already sold $325 million worth of stolen USDT (Tether’s stablecoin) for Ether. The reasoning behind this was to swap an asset that could be frozen with one that could not. Luckily, stablecoin issuers were quick to act, with Tether’s first major freeze coming just 37 minutes after the stolen funds reached the hackers’ main wallet, and Circle following three minutes later, blocking the movement of USDC. Without Tether and Circle intervening, far more of the funds could have ended up beyond their reach. We’re yet to agree on the rules The freeze, to its credit, worked for the most part because a handful of companies decided, in real time, to use it. The problem is that there still isn’t an agreed standard that outlines when a freeze is justified or how quickly the response needs to be, and we’re beginning to see the consequences of not having these answers. For instance, Circle is facing a proposed class action from Drift Protocol investors who allege it failed to freeze around $230 million in stolen USDC after the April hack. Their argument is that Circle could have stopped the money from moving, but didn’t act in time. Meanwhile, Tether is being sued in New York by two businessmen who claim it froze millions of their assets months before a seizure warrant existed. It’s important to mention that Tether has responded to this case, calling these allegations baseless. Working in payments and banking, it’s not uncommon for me to see traditional banks freeze money and accounts. Due to this, you may argue that if a bank can do this frequently, why shouldn’t a stablecoin issuer be able to? Stablecoin freeze timeline. Source: CertiK My argument isn’t that they shouldn’t. But banks don’t get to decide they want to freeze assets out of nowhere. There’s usually a legal trigger behind their decision, as well as a way to challenge it. Stablecoin issuers now hold the same power while having to act faster and across borders. So it’s about time they’re given some structure. Britain can fix this There is, however, a caveat with regulating stablecoin issuers. Tether and Circle, two of the largest issuers, aren’t based in the UK, so British regulators can’t simply tell them what to do. Related: Binance traces $6.3B hack to fake job interviews, compromised AI tool What Britain can control, though, is which stablecoins UK customers are allowed to buy, and they’ve already begun doing so. In June, the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) published its cryptoassets regime. Under it, UK trading platforms must carry out due diligence and publish a disclosure document before they list a coin, and that includes stablecoins issued overseas. It comes into force on 25 October 2027. The Bank of England is finalizing its Code of Practice for systemic stablecoin issuers by the end of this year. It covers stablecoins used widely enough for payments to matter to UK financial stability. Neither framework establishes the clear obligations around freezing stolen funds that I believe are necessary. But both are still taking shape, giving the UK the perfect opportunity to address this gap now, rather than trying to retrofit new requirements later. Two conditions for a UK listing So here’s a solution that I believe would work. Before a stablecoin can be sold on a UK platform, its issuer should have to agree to two conditions. The first being that it is contactable and ready to act. Tether and Circle did exactly that last week, but the victim was the world’s biggest exchange. A small UK platform should get the same response. I work with a number of smaller crypto businesses that don’t have Binance’s profile or a direct line to Tether. Under the current system, they’re the ones most likely to be left waiting. The second is that there needs to be a clear timetable for what happens next. If an issuer freezes funds, it should notify the National Crime Agency that same day. The freeze should then expire if there hasn’t been a court order put out to keep the wallet frozen. Neither of these are extremely controversial takes. They’d give law enforcement a chance to intervene when money is stolen and also protect people from having their assets frozen indefinitely, without legal grounds. The Binance hack has shown us that stablecoins can give victims of crypto crime a chance to stop stolen money before it’s gone for good. That shouldn’t be a privilege reserved only for the world’s biggest exchanges. Magazine: Can decentralized phone networks power the AI revolution?

news.title: Strategy buys 1,036 Bitcoin as BTC holdings climb to 850,364
news.summary: Strategy bought $81.9 million in Bitcoin last week while spending $188.3 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, according to its latest SEC filing.

news.titleTr: Strategy buys 1,036 Bitcoin as BTC holdings climb to 850,364
news.summaryTr: Strategy bought $81.9 million in Bitcoin last week while spending $188.3 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, according to its latest SEC filing.
news.articleText: Strategy buys 1,036 Bitcoin as BTC holdings climb to 850,364 Strategy bought $81.9 million in Bitcoin last week while spending $188.3 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, according to its latest SEC filing. Strategy bought 1,036 Bitcoin for $81.9 million last week, bringing its holdings to 850,364 BTC. The company paid an average of $79,012 per BTC last week, according to its Monday filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission. Strategy said it paid a total of $64.16 billion for its Bitcoin holdings, at an average price of $75,456 per coin. Its holdings now account for roughly 4.05% of Bitcoin’s maximum 21 million supply. Since the start of October, Strategy has spent about $1.06 billion buying back its STRC preferred shares, nearly five times the $219.7 million it spent on Bitcoin over the same period. Strategy spends $188.3 million on STRC buybacks Strategy raised $283.8 million in net proceeds last week by selling about $2.05 million shares of tis common stock (MSTR) through its at-the-market offering program. Strategy used $188.3 million of those proceeds to repurchase about 1.89 million STRC shares, following $208.2 million in buybacks the previous week. It spent $81.9 million on Bitcoin and allocated another $13.6 million to its USD Cash balance. Related: Strategy shareholders approve daily dividends for four preferred stocks Strategy’s separate US dollar reserve fell to $4.77 billion from $4.79 billion after the company drew $21.1 million to pay dividends on its preferred stock. Its USD Cash balance rose about 10% to $146.2 million from $132.7 million. The latest Bitcoin purchase follows Strategy’s acquisition of 811 BTC for $65.5 million the previous week. Strategy’s common stock fell 3% to $125 in Monday’s premarket trading, while its STRC preferred shares edged down 0.06% to $99.7, according to Yahoo Finance. Katarlı yetkili, anlaşma önerisinin içeriğine ilişkin basında yer alan iddiaların gerçeği yansıtmadığını bildirdi. ABD ile İran arasında yürütülen diplomatik temaslara ilişkin Katar'dan yeni bir açıklama geldi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Katarlı bir yetkili, Washington ve Tahran yönetimlerinin olası anlaşmanın ayrıntılarını arabulucularla görüşmeye devam ettiğini bildirdi. Açıklamada, görüşmelerin içeriğine ve olası anlaşmanın koşullarına ilişkin ayrıntı paylaşılmadı. Katar'ın arabuluculuk girişimleri sürüyor Katar, ABD ile İran arasındaki gerilimin diplomatik yollarla çözülmesi amacıyla yürütülen temaslarda arabulucu rolünü sürdürüyor. Katar Dışişleri Bakanlığı, 3 Kasım'daki açıklamasında tarafların sunulan önerileri değerlendirdiğini ve görüş ayrılıklarının giderilmesi için temasların devam ettiğini duyurmuştu. mofa.gov.qa Öte yandan ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın 9 Kasım'da Katar Başbakanı Şeyh Muhammed bin Abdurrahman Al Sani ile Beyaz Saray'da görüşmesi bekleniyor. Görüşmenin gündeminde İran ile yürütülen diplomatik girişimler bulunuyor
