news.title: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy
news.summary: The billionaire tech executive finds himself mired in a personal and national security scandal.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy
news.summaryTr: The billionaire tech executive finds himself mired in a personal and national security scandal.
news.articleText: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy - Published One of the Artificial Intelligence (AI) industry's most important figures has been accused of having an affair with a suspected Chinese spy, prompting an investigation. US intelligence officials believed that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Nvidia CEO and co-founder Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report., external On Sunday, Huang admitted, external to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. US tech giant Nvidia, one of the most valuable companies in the world, has opened an independent investigation into the reports. The firm said it does not believe US national security had been compromised - and added that Huang was committed to continuing to lead the company. Here is what we know about the affair and why it matters. - Why Trump is all-in on AI despite the warnings - Published16 September - What is AI, how does it work and why are some people concerned about it? - Published14 September Who is Alice Huang and what do we know about the affair? US officials believed that Alice Huang had been recruited to spy by China's top intelligence agency, the New York Times reported. Her current whereabouts are unknown. Alice Huang, who is of no relation to Jensen Huang, was a top executive at Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed. The firm had been suspected of helping divert Nvidia chips to China, a concern that Nvidia maintains was investigated and debunked. However, the BBC understands Megaspeed is under investigation by the Singapore government regarding previous allegations that the company was circumventing US sanctions on the export of Nvidia's high-end chips. The company told the New York Times last month its current leadership took the allegations seriously and had appointed external legal advisers to conduct an internal investigation. Surveillance reportedly revealed communications between Alice Huang and an American citizen, who was subsequently identified as Jensen Huang through a process known as "unmasking". It remains unclear what, if any, intellegence Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly gathered and passed to Beijing. She did not respond to the paper's request for comment. When the BBC asked Nvidia if the company was aware of intelligence concerns, the company said it was not. "We trust that if we were the target of a genuine threat, the US government would have notified us," an Nvidia spokesperson told the BBC. China has previously rejected the spying allegations, with a spokesperson saying that "the allegations about Chinese spies are entirely groundless, speculative and intended to smear and malign China". The New York Times reported in late October that Trump had been briefed last year on intelligence alleging Alice Huang was spying on China's behalf. Asked by reporters on Sunday whether he wished he had "acted on the intelligence", Trump responded: "No, I don't think so. I think he's an honourable guy." US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, meanwhile, refused to comment when asked about Huang. Last spring, the secretary of state reportedly oversaw the drafting of a memo that warned the Trump administration about Huang's relationship with the Chinese businesswoman, according to the New York Times. Why does it matter? Nvidia is at the heart of US and China's AI race, which is why the billionaire's affair has sparked national security fears among American lawmakers. Trump has said "whoever wins AI wins", and the fear is that if China gains the upper hand in AI, it will supercharge the country's military and surveillance capabilities. The US advantage is in large part because of US companies like Nvidia, working with producers like the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), which makes more than 90% of the world's most advanced chips. Since 2022, the US has used various export controls to keep the top tech out of China, which it says helps retain America's competitive edge and protects its national security. This means companies like Nvidia have been largely locked out of the world's most lucrative market, with Huang once saying that Nvidia's share of the Chinese market had gone from around 95% to effectively zero. Huang has engaged in shuttle diplomacy between Washington and Beijing, hoping to find a US-approved way back in, and shaping US policy on China along the way. Sunday's revelations may explain why Huang has failed to bring home the biggest prize of all to Nvidia: the Trump administration's blessing to sell all but its most advanced chips to China. Who is Jensen Huang? Born in Taiwan in 1963, Huang was nine years old when his family moved to the West Coast of the US. He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a master's degree in the same field from Stanford University. Huang then worked at US chip firm AMD before co-founding Nvidia. Known as "Daddy Huang" in Taiwan and once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech", he has a reputation as a workaholic and perfectionist with incredibly high standards for his staff. He has an estimated fortune of $155bn (£115bn), according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine, a biography on Huang, told the BBC, adding that he was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today. Huang has a famously close relationship with Trump. At the recent AI summit at the White House, where 42 tech executives were present, the president was flanked by Elon Musk and Huang. Trump said he had not spoken to the Nvidia boss since news of the investigation emerged. "I just know he's a fine person, but you never know what's going on," Trump told reporters, adding that he had "done an amazing job for our country". What is Nvidia and how important is it? Founded by Huang and fellow electrical engineers Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem in 1993, the company was originally known for chips that process graphics, particularly for computer games. Eventually it changed focus to AI, a field it now dominates. Huang rescued Nvidia from bankruptcy on more than one occasion, and took risks on AI a long time before the rest of the world did, effectively building the infrastructure from scratch. "Today when we think of that, we think of these giant data centres - none of that existed. There were no customers for the stuff he was building. In fact his first customer was Open AI at the time they had 30 people - he actually gave it to them, he donated it to them," Witt told the BBC. Every notable tech company building AI tools and infrastructure, including Amazon, Meta, Google, and Microsoft, now use Nvidia chips. Currently worth $4.5tn (£3.4tn), Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies ever. For now, the firm's board appears to have little appetite for removing Huang, saying in a statement on Sunday that they have "confidence in Jensen and his leadership team". Sources tell the BBC his removal is unlikely because there is so much money at stake. There is no public succession plan for the 63-year-old. He has often said he hopes to continue in the role for decades, and Bloomberg reports he has created an informal leadership structure around him unlike a traditional company's hierarchy. His children, Spencer and Madison, and son-in-law Nico Caprez work at Nvidia in senior roles. Who is Jensen Huang's wife? Huang met his future wife Lori Mills at Oregon State University while studying electrical engineering in the early 1980s. The pair were lab partners. They married in 1985, about eight years before he co-founded Nvidia, and have two children, Madison and Spencer. In 2007, the couple founded the Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation. The charitable fund has seen its assets surge in recent years, driven by the soaring value of Nvidia shares, and is estimated to be worth more than $9bn. Its donations include tens of millions of dollars to engineering programmes at Oregon State and Stanford University. Witt told the BBC than Huang has gone to great lengths to present himself as a family man, adding: "That's very important to him". "He praises his wife, he talks about her in very glowing ways," he added. "The fallout of this would be bad for anyone's family. But for someone who has gone to such great lengths to cultivate an image of being a family guy and who keeps his children very close, it is very bad." Additional reporting by Tom McArthur in London, Ayeshea Perera and Tessa Wong in Singapore and Helen Davidson in Sydney - Published21 September

news.title: Almanya'da 108 yıllık çalışma yasası tartışılıyor: Mesai 13 saate çıkabilir mi?
news.summary: Almanya'da 1918'den bu yana uygulanan 8 saatlik günlük çalışma sınırının haftalık sisteme dönüştürülmesi tartışılıyor. Hükümette uzlaşma sağlanamazken işverenler daha esnek çalışma saatleri, sendikalar ise mevcut sınırın korunmasını istiyor.

news.titleTr: Almanya'da 108 yıllık çalışma yasası tartışılıyor: Mesai 13 saate çıkabilir mi?
news.summaryTr: Almanya'da 1918'den bu yana uygulanan 8 saatlik günlük çalışma sınırının haftalık sisteme dönüştürülmesi tartışılıyor. Hükümette uzlaşma sağlanamazken işverenler daha esnek çalışma saatleri, sendikalar ise mevcut sınırın korunmasını istiyor.
news.articleText: Almanya'da 108 yıllık çalışma yasası tartışılıyor: Mesai 13 saate çıkabilir mi? - Almanya'da 1918'den bu yana uygulanan 8 saatlik günlük çalışma sınırının haftalık sisteme dönüştürülmesi tartışılıyor. Hükümette uzlaşma sağlanamazken işverenler daha esnek çalışma saatleri, sendikalar ise mevcut sınırın korunmasını istiyor. Almanya'da 1918'den bu yana uygulanan 8 saatlik günlük çalışma süresi sınırı, hükümetin çalışma yasasında değişiklik hazırlığıyla yeniden tartışmaya açıldı. Ancak Hristiyan Birlik partileri ile Sosyal Demokrat Parti'den (SPD) oluşan koalisyon, günlük sınırın yerine haftalık çalışma süresi sınırı getirilmesi konusunda henüz uzlaşamadı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Başbakan Friedrich Merz, 13 Ekim'de yaptığı açıklamada 8 saati aşan çalışma günlerinin tek başına çalışanların sömürülmesi anlamına gelmediğini savunarak daha esnek çalışma modellerini destekledi. Buna karşılık sendikalar, günlük çalışma süresi sınırının korunmasını istiyor. Almanya'da çalışma hayatında yeni dönem hazırlığı Mevcut düzenlemeye göre Almanya'da günlük çalışma süresi kural olarak 8 saat. Bu süre, 6 aylık veya 24 haftalık dönemde günlük ortalama 8 saati aşmamak koşuluyla 10 saate çıkarılabiliyor. Haftada 6 iş günü üzerinden hesaplandığında haftalık üst sınır 48 saate ulaşıyor. İki iş günü arasında en az 11 saat dinlenme zorunluluğu bulunuyor. 8 saatlik mesai sınırı gündemde Haziran ayında hazırlanan taslak, 8 saatlik günlük sınırı temel kural olarak korurken, haftalık çalışma süresi modeline yalnızca toplu iş sözleşmeleriyle geçilmesine imkan tanıyor. Ayrıca elektronik çalışma süresi kaydı zorunluluğu getirilmesi öngörülüyor. İşveren örgütleri taslağı yetersiz bulurken sendikalar çalışma gününün uzamasına karşı çıkıyor. Araştırmaların uzun çalışma sürelerinin iş kazası riskini artırdığına ve çalışanların sosyal yaşama katılımını olumsuz etkileyebildiğine işaret ettiği aktarılıyor.

Türkiye Bankalar Birliği (TBB) Risk Merkezi tarafından gerçek ve tüzel kişilere sunulan Risk Merkezi Raporu'na iki yeni bilgi başlığı eklendi. Böylece kredi başvurusunun şube, mobil bankacılık veya internet bankacılığı aracılığıyla yapıldığı bilgisine erişilebilecek. Rapora eklenen diğer başlık ise "Kurul Kararını (10746 Sayılı) Aşan Kredi Bilgileri" oldu. Bu kapsamda gerçek kişilerin ticari işletmeleri ile tüzel kişilere ait bilgiler; banka adı ve belgenin eksik olduğu döneme ilişkin verilerle birlikte raporda yer alacak. Risk Merkezi Raporu'na nasıl ulaşılır? Risk Merkezi Raporu'na TBB'nin riskmerkezi.org internet sitesi, e-Devlet Kapısı ve e-Devlet mobil uygulaması üzerinden erişilebiliyor. news.summary: Tether Gold, 2026'nın ilk üç çeyreğinde fiziksel altın rezervlerini yüzde 59 artırarak 827 bin 418 troy onsa, yaklaşık 25,7 tona çıkardı. Rezervlerin piyasa değeri 3,44 milyar dolara ulaşırken yatırımcıların yılbaşından bu yana 9 tonun üzerinde altına karşılık gelen token satın aldığı bildirildi.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Dünyanın en büyük altın tokeni bu yıl altın rezervlerini yüzde 59 artırdı
news.summaryTr: Tether Gold, 2026'nın ilk üç çeyreğinde fiziksel altın rezervlerini yüzde 59 artırarak 827 bin 418 troy onsa, yaklaşık 25,7 tona çıkardı. Rezervlerin piyasa değeri 3,44 milyar dolara ulaşırken yatırımcıların yılbaşından bu yana 9 tonun üzerinde altına karşılık gelen token satın aldığı bildirildi.
news.articleText: Dünyanın en büyük altın tokeni bu yıl altın rezervlerini yüzde 59 artırdı - Tether Gold, 2026'nın ilk üç çeyreğinde fiziksel altın rezervlerini yüzde 59 artırarak 827 bin 418 troy onsa, yaklaşık 25,7 tona çıkardı. Rezervlerin piyasa değeri 3,44 milyar dolara ulaşırken yatırımcıların yılbaşından bu yana 9 tonun üzerinde altına karşılık gelen token satın aldığı bildirildi. Piyasa değeri bakımından dünyanın en büyük tokenize altın ürünü Tether Gold (XAUT), 2026 yılının üçüncü çeyreğinde büyümesini sürdürdü. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Altın fiyatlarındaki dalgalanmalara rağmen yatırımcılar yılbaşından bu yana 9 tonun üzerinde fiziksel altına karşılık gelen XAUT satın aldı. Bu gelişme, tokenize altına yönelik talebin kısa vadeli fiyat hareketlerinden ziyade uzun vadeli yatırım yaklaşımıyla şekillendiğini ortaya koydu. XAUT'yi destekleyen fiziksel altın rezervleri, 2025 yılı sonundaki 520 bin 89 troy onstan 827 bin 418 troy ons seviyesine yükseldi. Böylece rezervler yüzde 59 artarken İsviçre'de tutulan rezervlere 766 yeni altın külçesi eklendi. Toplam külçe sayısı 2 bin 57'ye ulaşırken rezervlerin piyasa değeri yüzde 53 artışla 2,25 milyar dolardan 3,44 milyar dolara çıktı. XAUT'nin fiziksel altın teminatı güçleniyor Tether Gold'u ihraç eden ve El Salvador'un Dijital Varlık İhracı Yasası kapsamında faaliyet gösteren TG Commodities, S.A. de C.V., 30 Eylül 2026 itibarıyla üçüncü çeyrek rezerv verilerini açıkladı. Rapora göre: - Toplam fiziksel altın rezervi: Yaklaşık 25,7 ton - Toplam XAUT arzı: 827 bin 417,63 XAUT - Satışı gerçekleştirilen token miktarı: 709 bin 323,66 XAUT - Satışa hazır token miktarı: 118 bin 93,97 XAUT - Altının ons fiyatı: 4.157,41 dolar - Toplam rezerv değeri: 3,44 milyar dolar Her bir XAUT, bir troy ons saf fiziksel altınla bire bir destekleniyor. İsviçre'de saklanan ve London Good Delivery kalite standartlarını karşılayan rezervler, token sahiplerine belirli altın külçeleri üzerinde mülkiyet hakkı sağlıyor. Üçüncü çeyrek sonunda satılmış tokenları destekleyen altının piyasa değeri yaklaşık 2,95 milyar dolar, satışa hazır tokenlara karşılık gelen altının değeri ise yaklaşık 491 milyon dolar olarak kaydedildi. Paolo Ardoino: "XAUT, fiziksel altın sahipliğini dönüştürüyor" Tether CEO'su Paolo Ardoino, konuya ilişkin değerlendirmesinde şunları söyledi: "Binlerce yıl boyunca altın sahibi olmak, onu saklaması için başka birine güvenmek anlamına geliyordu. XAUT bunu değiştiriyor. Her token, herkesin doğrulayabileceği gerçek altın külçelerine bağlı. Bu yıl yatırımcılar, dalgalı piyasa koşullarına rağmen varlıklarına 9 tonun üzerinde altın ekledi. Dünya Altın Konseyi, dijital altının 700 milyar dolarlık yeni bir talep yaratabileceğini öngörüyor. XAUT'nin bu pazardan önemli bir pay almasını bekliyoruz." Tether Gold, bire bir fiziksel altın teminatı, İsviçre'de saklanan rezervleri ve blokzincir üzerindeki şeffaflığıyla tokenize gerçek dünya varlıkları pazarındaki konumunu güçlendirmeyi hedefliyor.

news.title: TikTok'ta yeni akım: Halay ve horon çektirerek para kazanıyorlar
news.summary: Slime yayınlarının ardından TikTok'ta bu kez izleyicilerin yorum ve hediyelerle ekrandaki karakterlere halay ve horon çektirebildiği canlı yayınlar gündemde. Peki, bu yayınlar nasıl çalışıyor ve yayıncılar nasıl para kazanıyor?
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: TikTok'ta yeni akım: Halay ve horon çektirerek para kazanıyorlar
news.summaryTr: Slime yayınlarının ardından TikTok'ta bu kez izleyicilerin yorum ve hediyelerle ekrandaki karakterlere halay ve horon çektirebildiği canlı yayınlar gündemde. Peki, bu yayınlar nasıl çalışıyor ve yayıncılar nasıl para kazanıyor?
news.articleText: TikTok'ta yeni akım: Halay ve horon çektirerek para kazanıyorlar - Slime yayınlarının ardından TikTok'ta bu kez izleyicilerin yorum ve hediyelerle ekrandaki karakterlere halay ve horon çektirebildiği canlı yayınlar gündemde. Peki, bu yayınlar nasıl çalışıyor ve yayıncılar nasıl para kazanıyor? TikTok'ta canlı yayınlar farklı bir boyuta taşınıyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Slime yoğurarak sanal hediye toplayan yayıncıların ardından bu kez izleyicilerin yorum ve hediyelerle ekrandaki karakterlere halay ve horon çektirebildiği yayınlar gündeme geldi. Etkileşimli yayınlarda kullanıcılar yalnızca izleyici olarak kalmıyor, gönderdikleri yorum ve hediyelerle yayının akışını da değiştirebiliyor. İzleyenler yayının başından ayrılamıyor X'te paylaşılan bir horon videosu sosyal medya kullanıcılarının dikkatini çekti. Bir kullanıcı, 6 Kasım'daki paylaşımında, "Slime yayını falan hikaye TikTok'ta horon yaptırıyor adam sabahın köründe esir etti yarım saat." ifadelerini kullandı. Yorum yazan halaya katılıyor, hediye gönderen horon başı oluyor Sosyal medyada paylaşılan örneklerde, canlı yayını izleyen kullanıcılar belirli kelimeleri yorum olarak yazarak sanal dans halkasına katılabiliyor. Örneğin kullanıcıların "HORON" yazmasıyla karakterler dans etmeye başlıyor. Beğeniler dansın hızını etkilerken gönderilen sanal hediyeler karakterlere farklı roller kazandırabiliyor. Gül hediyesi gönderen bir izleyici horon halkasına dahil edilirken, başka bir hediye gönderen kullanıcı kemençeci olabiliyor. En fazla hediye gönderen izleyiciye ise horon başı rolü verilebiliyor. Böylece kullanıcılar yorumları ve hediyeleriyle ekrandaki görüntüyü doğrudan değiştirebiliyor. Halayı yapay zeka mı çekiyor? Bu yayınların tamamında yapay zeka kullanılmıyor. Bazı sistemlerde izleyicinin yazdığı kelimeler önceden belirlenmiş komutlarla eşleştiriliyor ve karakterler bu komutlara göre hareket ediyor. Daha gelişmiş sistemlerde ise yapay zeka, izleyici yorumlarını analiz ederek karakterlerin yapacağı hareketleri belirleyebiliyor. Ekranda görülen halay ve horon her zaman yapay zekayla üretilmiş bir video anlamına gelmiyor. Bu yayınlar, canlı yayına entegre edilen etkileşimli oyunlarla da hazırlanabiliyor. TikTok'ta halay ve horon çekerek nasıl para kazanılıyor? İnteraktif halay ve horon yayınlarının gelir modeli, TikTok'un sanal hediye sistemine dayanıyor. Kullanıcılar, gerçek para karşılığında satın aldıkları Coin'lerle canlı yayıncılara çeşitli hediyeler gönderebiliyor. Yayıncılar da bu hediyeler üzerinden TikTok'un belirlediği koşullara göre Diamond (elmas) ödülleri kazanabiliyor. Biriken ödüller, platformun ödeme şartlarının karşılanması halinde para olarak çekilebiliyor. Böylece izleyicilerin yayına katılımı, yayıncılar açısından bir kazanç modeline dönüşüyor.

news.titleTr: Enerjinin geleceği için yarıştılar: 423 başvurudan 3 kazanan çıktı
news.summaryTr: EPDK onayıyla Adm ve Gdz Elektrik tarafından hayata geçirilen GridUp Hızlandırma Programı'nın ilk dönemi tamamlandı. Elektrik dağıtım sektörüne yenilikçi çözümler sunan 423 başvuru arasından seçilen 3 girişime toplam 550 bin TL para ödülü verildi.
news.articleText: Enerjinin geleceği için yarıştılar: 423 başvurudan 3 kazanan çıktı - EPDK onayıyla Adm ve Gdz Elektrik tarafından hayata geçirilen GridUp Hızlandırma Programı'nın ilk dönemi tamamlandı. Elektrik dağıtım sektörüne yenilikçi çözümler sunan 423 başvuru arasından seçilen 3 girişime toplam 550 bin TL para ödülü verildi. Enerji Piyasası Düzenleme Kurumu (EPDK) tarafından onaylanan ve Adm ile Gdz Elektrik tarafından yürütülen GridUp Hızlandırma Programı, Bodrum'da düzenlenen DemoDay etkinliğiyle ilk dönemini tamamladı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Aydem Enerji bünyesinde, Aydın, Denizli, Muğla, İzmir ve Manisa'da faaliyet gösteren Adm ve Gdz Elektrik tarafından hayata geçirilen programın ilk dönemi, Bodrum'da düzenlenen DemoDay etkinliğiyle sona erdi. Elektrik dağıtım sektörünün saha ihtiyaçlarına yönelik yenilikçi çözümlerin geliştirilmesini amaçlayan programın finali, sektör temsilcilerini bir araya getirdi. Girişimcilerin, akademisyenlerin, teknoloji geliştiricilerinin, sektör profesyonellerinin ve basın mensuplarının katıldığı etkinlikte jüri değerlendirmeleri sonrasında ilk üçe giren firmalar belirlendi. Connect Ion, “Akıllı Saha Operasyonları ve İş Güvenliği” projesiyle birinci, Onna Robotics, “Demonte Modem Test Sistemi” projesiyle ikinci, Electral, “Bakım Yönetim Yazılımı” projesiyle üçüncü oldu. Birinciye 300 bin TL, ikinciye 160 bin TL, üçüncüye ise 90 bin TL ödül verildi. Elektrik dağıtım sektörüne yenilikçi çözümler kazandırmayı amaçlayan program Ocak 2026'da başladı. Toplam 423 başvurunun alındığı programda final aşamasına gelene kadar farklı şehirlerde girişimci buluşmaları gerçekleştirildi. Fikir geliştirmeden veri analizine ve teknoloji üretimine kadar uzanan çalışmalar kapsamında İzmir'de başlayan girişimci buluşmaları, ilerleyen aşamalarda Denizli, İstanbul ve Ankara'da yapıldı. Final programı öncesi gerçek çalışma koşullarında yapılan testlerle, projelerin uygulanabilirliği ve sağlayabileceği faydalar değerlendirildi. Saha ihtiyaçlarına yönelik yenilikçi çözümler Programın sonunda birincilik ödülünü Akıllı Saha Operasyonları ve İş Güvenliği projesiyle Connect Ion kazandı. Proje, elektrik arızalarında ve saha çalışmalarında görev alacak ekiplerin daha etkin belirlenmesini amaçlıyor. Ekiplerin yetkinliklerini, ihtiyaç duydukları araç ve malzemeleri, çalışma koşullarını ve iş sağlığı ve güvenliğini dikkate alarak görev dağılımını kolaylaştırıyor. İkincilik ödülünün sahibi Onna Robotics ise elektrik sayaçlarından alınan verileri ileten modemlerin yeniden kullanılmadan önce çalışıp çalışmadığını kontrol eden bir sistem geliştirdi. Böylece arızalı cihazlar önceden tespit edilirken, çalışan modemlerin yeniden kullanılmasıyla kaynak tasarrufuna katkı sağlanıyor. Üçüncülük ödülünü kazanan Electral, elektrik şebekesindeki ekipmanların bakım ve onarım süreçlerini kolaylaştıran bir yazılım geliştirdi. Sistem, bakım çalışmalarının planlanmasını ve önceliklendirilmesini kolaylaştırırken tüm süreçlerin tek platform üzerinden takip edilmesini hedefliyor. Böylece olası arızaların önlenmesine ve elektrik dağıtım hizmetlerinin daha verimli yürütülmesine katkıda bulunuyor. Emrah Kalkan: “Teknolojinin değerini sahada ürettiği faydayla ölçüyoruz” Adm Elektrik Genel Müdürü Emrah Kalkan, programın sektörün somut ihtiyaçlarına odaklandığını belirterek, “Elektrik dağıtımında üstlendiğimiz sorumluluk, enerji altyapımızı ve hizmetlerimizi sürekli geliştirmeyi gerektiriyor. Teknolojiye yatırım yaparken temel ölçütümüz, geliştirilen çözümün gerçek bir ihtiyacı karşılaması ve ölçülebilir fayda sağlaması. GridUp'ta girişimcilerimizle operasyon ekiplerimizi bir araya getirerek fikirleri gerçek çalışma koşullarında değerlendirme fırsatı bulduk. Operasyonlarımızı daha verimli hale getirecek, çalışanlarımızın güvenliğini artıracak ve veriye dayalı karar alma süreçlerimizi güçlendirecek çözümler üzerinde çalıştık. Önümüzdeki dönemde başarılı sonuç veren uygulamaların yaygınlaştırılma imkânlarını değerlendirmeyi ve bu iş birliklerini kalıcı faydaya dönüştürmeyi hedefliyoruz” diye konuştu. Ahmet Bayramoğlu: “Ortak deneyim, yeni teknolojilerin önünü açıyor” Gdz Elektrik Genel Müdürü Ahmet Bayramoğlu, GridUp'ın oluşturduğu iş birliği ortamının sektörün dönüşümü açısından önem taşıdığını ifade ederek, şunları söyledi: “Dijitalleşme, yapay zekâ ve veri analitiği, elektrik dağıtımında çalışma ve karar alma biçimlerimizi geliştiriyor. Bu dönüşüme katkı sunabilmek için saha deneyimimizi farklı uzmanlıklarla buluşturmamız gerekiyor. GridUp'ta girişimcilerin yeni bakış açıları, ekiplerimizin deneyimi ve akademinin bilgi birikimi birbirini tamamladı. Sektörümüzün pek çok ortak ihtiyacı var. Bir sahada geliştirilen çözüm başka bir bölgede de karşılık bulabilir, paylaşılan deneyim yeni çalışmaların önünü açabilir. GridUp'ın oluşturduğu iş birliği ağının gelişmesini, yeni teknolojilerin uygulama alanı bulmasını ve sektörümüzün teknoloji geliştirme kapasitesinin güçlenmesine katkı sunmayı hedefliyoruz.” GridUp Hızlandırma Programı kapsamında geliştirilen teknolojilerin ve dereceye giren projelerin, gerekli uygunluk değerlendirmelerinin ardından Adm ve Gdz Elektrik'in operasyonel süreçlerinde kullanılması ve uzun vadeli çözüm ortaklıklarına dönüştürülmesi amaçlanıyor. Programın gelecek yıl ikinci döneminin gerçekleştirilmesi de hedefler arasında yer alıyor.

news.title: COP31'de BRICS girişimi: Rusya ayrı müzakere grubu oluşturulmasını istiyor
news.summary: Rusya Ekonomik Kalkınma Bakanı Maksim Reşetnikov, COP31 kapsamında BRICS ülkelerinin BM iklim müzakerelerinde ayrı bir grup oluşturmasını hedeflediklerini açıkladı. Moskova, iklim politikalarının ticarette korumacılık aracına dönüşmemesi gerektiğini de savundu.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: COP31'de BRICS girişimi: Rusya ayrı müzakere grubu oluşturulmasını istiyor
news.summaryTr: Rusya Ekonomik Kalkınma Bakanı Maksim Reşetnikov, COP31 kapsamında BRICS ülkelerinin BM iklim müzakerelerinde ayrı bir grup oluşturmasını hedeflediklerini açıkladı. Moskova, iklim politikalarının ticarette korumacılık aracına dönüşmemesi gerektiğini de savundu.
news.articleText: COP31'de BRICS girişimi: Rusya ayrı müzakere grubu oluşturulmasını istiyor - Rusya Ekonomik Kalkınma Bakanı Maksim Reşetnikov, COP31 kapsamında BRICS ülkelerinin BM iklim müzakerelerinde ayrı bir grup oluşturmasını hedeflediklerini açıkladı. Moskova, iklim politikalarının ticarette korumacılık aracına dönüşmemesi gerektiğini de savundu. Rusya Ekonomik Kalkınma Bakanı Maksim Reşetnikov, Türkiye'nin ev sahipliğinde Antalya'da düzenlenen Birleşmiş Milletler (BM) İklim Değişikliği Çerçeve Sözleşmesi'nin 31. Taraflar Konferansı'nda (COP31), BRICS ülkelerinin iklim müzakerelerinde ayrı bir grup oluşturmasını hedeflediklerini söyledi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Reşetnikov, Rus haber ajansı İnterfaks'a verdiği röportajda, Türkiye'de düzenlenen COP31'e ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulundu. BRICS ülkelerinin iklim müzakerelerindeki işbirliğini güçlendirmek istediklerini belirten Reşetnikov, "Bir sonraki adım, BM iklim müzakereleri kapsamında ayrı bir BRICS müzakere grubu oluşturmak. BRICS ülkelerinin küresel iklim kurallarının şekillendirilmesinde daha aktif rol almasını istiyoruz." dedi. Rusya'nın 2024'te BRICS dönem başkanlığı sırasında İklim Değişikliği ve Sürdürülebilir Kalkınma Temas Grubu'nun kurulmasına öncülük ettiğini anımsatan Reşetnikov, karbon piyasaları, bilimsel çalışmalar ve ticaret alanlarında işbirliğini geliştirdiklerini kaydetti. Reşetnikov, 2027'de Etiyopya'da düzenlenecek COP32'ye yönelik hazırlıkları da Antalya'daki konferansta Etiyopyalı yetkililerle görüşeceklerini bildirdi. Rusya'nın COP31'de teknolojik tarafsızlık ilkesini savunacağını aktaran Reşetnikov, nükleer enerji, doğal gaz ve yenilenebilir enerji kaynaklarının emisyonların azaltılmasında rol oynayabileceğini ifade etti. Avrupa Birliği'nin (AB) Sınırda Karbon Düzenleme Mekanizması'nı (SKDM) eleştiren Reşetnikov, iklim politikalarının ticarette yeni korumacılık araçlarına dönüşmemesi gerektiğini vurguladı. Reşetnikov, Rusya'nın Antalya'daki konferansta düşük karbonlu enerji, yeşil sanayi, sürdürülebilir şehirler ve iklim değişikliğine uyum alanlarındaki projelerini tanıtacağını da sözlerine ekledi.

news.summary: Euro Grubu Başkanı Kiryakos Pierrakakis, Avrupa Merkez Bankası (ECB) başkanlığına ilişkin seçim sürecinin yıl sonuna kadar tamamlanmasının hedeflendiğini açıkladı. news.titleTr: Tarih verildi: ECB'nin yeni başkanı Lagarde görevi bırakmadan belli olacak
news.summaryTr: Euro Grubu Başkanı Kiryakos Pierrakakis, Avrupa Merkez Bankası (ECB) başkanlığına ilişkin seçim sürecinin yıl sonuna kadar tamamlanmasının hedeflendiğini açıkladı. İspanya'nın Pablo Hernandez de Cos, Hollanda'nın ise Klaas Knot adaylığını sunduğu süreçte liderler düzeyinde siyasi uzlaşı aranacak.
news.articleText: Tarih verildi: ECB'nin yeni başkanı Lagarde görevi bırakmadan belli olacak - Euro Grubu Başkanı Kiryakos Pierrakakis, Avrupa Merkez Bankası (ECB) başkanlığına ilişkin seçim sürecinin yıl sonuna kadar tamamlanmasının hedeflendiğini açıkladı. Euro Grubu Başkanı Kiryakos Pierrakakis, Avrupa Merkez Bankası (ECB) başkanlığı için İspanya ve Hollanda'nın adaylarının toplantıda tanıtılacağını belirterek seçim sürecinin liderler düzeyinde siyasi uzlaşıyla yürütülmesini ve yıl sonuna kadar tamamlanmasını beklediğini söyledi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Pierrakakis, Brüksel'de düzenlenen Euro Bölgesi maliye bakanları toplantısı öncesinde basına açıklamada bulundu. ECB başkanlığı için İspanya'dan Pablo Hernandez de Cos ve Hollanda'dan Klaas Knot'un aday gösterildiğini hatırlatan Pierrakakis, iki ülkenin bakanlarının toplantıda adayları tanıtacağını söyledi. Pierrakakis, gün içinde AB Konseyi Başkanı Antonio Costa ile seçim sürecini görüşmek üzere bir araya geleceğini belirtti. ECB Başkanı Christine Lagarde'ın 7 Şubat'a kadar görevinde kalacağını açıkladığına işaret eden Pierrakakis, yeni başkanın seçilmesi için takvimin oldukça sıkışık olduğunu vurguladı. Pierrakakis, hızlı hareket etmeleri gerektiğine dikkati çekerek, "Hedefimiz, tüm sürecin yıl sonuna kadar tamamlanması." ifadesini kullandı. Geçmişte ECB başkanının seçiminin liderlerin yön verdiği, siyasi uzlaşıya dayalı bir süreç olduğunu anlatan Pierrakakis, bu kez de aynı yaklaşımın izlenmesinin beklendiğini kaydetti. Pierrakakis, Euro Grubu'nun süreci kolaylaştırmak için üzerine düşeni yapacağını, bugünkü toplantıda konunun ağırlıklı olarak bilgilendirme amacıyla ele alınacağını söyledi. ECB'de aynı dönemde doldurulacak üç pozisyon bulunduğuna dikkati çeken Pierrakakis, bunların tamamını içeren bir paket üzerinde uzlaşı sağlanabileceğini belirtti.

news.titleTr: Zeytinyağı ucuzlayınca harekete geçtiler: 188 bin ton satışa sunulmayacak
news.summaryTr: Dünyanın en büyük zeytinyağı üreticisi İspanya, fiyatlardaki düşüşü durdurmak için tarihi bir karar aldı. Üretimin yüzde 12'sine denk gelen yaklaşık 188 bin ton zeytinyağı piyasadan çekilecek. Uygulama, Eylül 2027'ye kadar devam edecek.
news.articleText: Zeytinyağı ucuzlayınca harekete geçtiler: 188 bin ton satışa sunulmayacak - Dünyanın en büyük zeytinyağı üreticisi İspanya, fiyatlardaki düşüşü durdurmak için tarihi bir karar aldı. Üretimin yüzde 12'sine denk gelen yaklaşık 188 bin ton zeytinyağı piyasadan çekilecek. Uygulama, Eylül 2027'ye kadar devam edecek. Dünyanın en büyük zeytinyağı üreticisi İspanya, artan üretim ve yüksek stoklar nedeniyle gerileyen zeytinyağı fiyatlarını desteklemek amacıyla yeni bir düzenlemeyi hayata geçirdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İspanya Resmi Gazetesi'nde (BOE) yayımlanan karara göre, üreticiler aylık zeytinyağı üretimlerinin yüzde 12'sini piyasaya sunmak yerine depolamak zorunda kalacak. Bu kapsamda yaklaşık 188 bin ton zeytinyağının piyasadan çekilmesi öngörülüyor. Ülkede ilk kez uygulanacak düzenleme, 30 Eylül 2027 tarihine kadar yürürlükte kalacak. Ekim ayı ve önceki dönemlerde üretilen miktarlar uygulamanın dışında tutulacak. Zeytinyağı fiyatları yüzde 25 geriledi Kararın arkasında, İspanya'da zeytinyağı üretiminin toparlanması ve stokların yüksek seviyelere ulaşması bulunuyor. Resmi verilere göre ülke, yeni sezona 357 bin 40 ton stokla başladı. Sezon boyunca 1 milyon 602 bin 596 ton üretim yapılması bekleniyor. Böylece toplam arzın yaklaşık 1,96 milyon tona ulaşacağı tahmin ediliyor. Artan üretim fiyatları da aşağı çekti. Kasım ayı başında sızma zeytinyağının üretici fiyatı kilogram başına yaklaşık 3 euroya gerilerken, geçen yıl aynı dönemde 4 euro seviyesindeydi. Böylece fiyatlarda yıllık yaklaşık yüzde 25 düşüş yaşandı. Küresel fiyatları da etkileyebilir İspanya'nın aldığı karar, küresel zeytinyağı piyasası açısından da önem taşıyor. İspanya Tarım Bakanlığı'nın tahminlerine göre ülke, dünya zeytinyağı üretiminin yaklaşık yüzde 45'ini, Avrupa Birliği üretiminin ise yüzde 70'ini karşılıyor. Bu nedenle piyasaya sunulan zeytinyağı miktarının azaltılması, uluslararası fiyatları da etkileyebilir. Ancak depolanan ürünlerin sonraki döneme aktarılması, gelecek sezonda yeni bir arz baskısı oluşturabilir. Sektörde 520 milyon euroluk satın alma İspanya'da zeytinyağı sektöründe önemli bir satın alma anlaşması da gündemde. Dcoop ve Acesur, Carbonell ve Hojiblanca gibi markaları bünyesinde bulunduran Deoleo grubunun iştiraki Deoleo Holding'i satın almak üzere anlaşmaya vardı. Borçlar dahil şirketin tamamına 520 milyon euro değer biçilen anlaşma, toplam yüzde 91,99'luk payın devrini kapsıyor. Diğer hissedarların da katılması halinde alıcıların payı yüzde 100'e ulaşabilecek. Düzenleyici onaylara ve hissedarların kabulüne bağlı olan anlaşmanın açıklanmasının ardından Deoleo hisseleri perşembe günü yüzde 21,1 değer kaybetti.

news.title: Nine foreigners caught allegedly trying to leave South Africa to fight in Ukraine
news.summary: Police declined to disclose their nationalities but said none of them lived in South Africa.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Nine foreigners caught allegedly trying to leave South Africa to fight in Ukraine
news.summaryTr: Police declined to disclose their nationalities but said none of them lived in South Africa.
news.articleText: Nine foreigners caught allegedly trying to leave South Africa to fight in Ukraine - Published Nine foreigners have been arrested in South Africa after they were caught allegedly trying to leave the country to fight in the war between Russia and the Ukraine, police say. The group, aged between 20 and 26, were arrested in and around Johannesburg by a multidisciplinary team on Sunday evening. They were caught as they were "preparing to board flights out of the country", authorities added, but their final destination is unclear. The group is accused of contravening South Africa's laws, which outlaw mercenary activity without government permission. Police said the group were arrested at South Africa's biggest airport, OR Tambo, and a hotel in Bruma, east of Johannesburg by a multidisciplinary team that involved Interpol. The police statement added that the involvement of Interpol and other international law enforcement agencies indicated that the suspects had also allegedly violated laws in their respective home countries, prompting cooperation with South African authorities. Authorities declined to disclose the group's nationalities but confirmed that none of them resided in South Africa. They have also not said whether the group allegedly intended to fight for Russia or Ukraine nor provided details of the organisations allegedly involved in facilitating their travel. Citizens of several African countries, including Kenya, Ghana and South Africa, have gone to fight for Russia in Ukraine - some they had been duped and had not realised where they were going. A Ukrainian intelligence assessment estimated earlier this year that more than 1,700 people from 36 countries in Africa have been recruited to fight for Russia. Kenya at the time estimated that 252 citizens had been illegally conscripted in Russia. In March, Foreign Minister Musalia Mudavadi visited Moscow to address the issue. He said at the time that an agreement had been reached to stop recruiting Kenyan nationals. In February, Ghana said that 55 of its citizens had been killed in the conflict, with 272 believed to have been lured to fight since the war started in 2022. The same month, South Africa secured the return of 17 South Africans who were allegedly tricked into joining the war. In December last year, South African authorities arrested five people, including a journalist, for allegedly recruiting people to join the war. Ukraine has also been recruiting foreign nationals, including from Africa. The nine arrested are expected to appear in court either later on Monday or Tuesday. news.articleText: Altında kasım hesabı değişti mi? İslam Memiş yılın sonuna işaret etti Finans analisti İslam Memiş, ons altında kısa vadede 4.000-4.200 dolar bandının öne çıktığını belirtti. Memiş, sürpriz bir gelişme yaşanmaması halinde altının bu ayı söz konusu bantta tamamlayabileceğini söyledi. Finans analisti İslam Memiş, CNBC-e canlı yayınında altın ve piyasalara ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulundu. Kısa vadede altın fiyatlarında yüzde 5'lik tepki yükselişinin doğal olduğunu belirten Memiş, ABD'deki ara seçimlerin ardından piyasalarda oluşan rahatlamaya dikkat çekti. Ons altında 3.880-4.000 dolar bandının geride kaldığını ifade eden Memiş, kısa vadede 4.000-4.200 dolar aralığının öne çıktığını söyledi. Memiş, sürpriz bir gelişme yaşanmaması halinde altının bu ayı bu bantta tamamlayabileceğini, ilerleyen süreçte ise 4.200-4.400 dolar aralığının gündeme gelebileceğini belirtti. Fed'in faiz kararı ne olacak? Petrol fiyatlarında yaklaşık yüzde 10'luk düşüşün merkez bankalarının elini rahatlattığını ifade eden Memiş, bu hafta açıklanacak enflasyon verilerinin takip edilmesi gerektiğini söyledi. Memiş, Fed'in aralık ayındaki faiz toplantısında faizleri sabit tutma ihtimalini yüksek gördüğünü dile getirdi. Altın fiyatlarında ABD'den gelecek ekonomik veriler, Fed'in faiz politikası ve jeopolitik gelişmeler belirleyici olmaya devam ediyor. Memiş, yatırımcıların kısa vadeli işlemlerde riskleri göz önünde bulundurması gerektiğini vurguladı. Altın fiyatlarında son dönemde yaşanan yükselişte ABD'deki ara seçimlerin ardından piyasalarda artan iyimserlik, dolar ve petrol fiyatlarındaki hareketlilik ile Fed'in faiz politikasına ilişkin beklentiler etkili oluyor. Ons altın, kısa vadede 4.000-4.200 dolar bandında hareket ediyor.

Memiş, sürpriz bir gelişme yaşanmaması halinde altının bu ayı bu bantta tamamlayabileceğini, ilerleyen süreçte ise 4.200-4.400 dolar aralığının gündeme gelebileceğini belirtti. Fed'in faiz kararı ne olacak? Petrol fiyatlarında yaklaşık yüzde 10'luk düşüşün merkez bankalarının elini rahatlattığını ifade eden Memiş, bu hafta açıklanacak enflasyon verilerinin takip edilmesi gerektiğini söyledi. Memiş, Fed'in aralık ayındaki faiz toplantısında faizleri sabit tutma ihtimalini yüksek gördüğünü dile getirdi. Altın fiyatlarında ABD'den gelecek ekonomik veriler, Fed'in faiz politikası ve jeopolitik gelişmeler belirleyici olmaya devam ediyor. Memiş, yatırımcıların kısa vadeli işlemlerde riskleri göz önünde bulundurması gerektiğini vurguladı. Altın fiyatlarında son dönemde yaşanan yükselişte ABD'deki ara seçimlerin ardından piyasalarda artan iyimserlik, dolar ve petrol fiyatlarındaki hareketlilik ile Fed'in faiz politikasına ilişkin beklentiler etkili oluyor. Ons altın, kısa vadede 4.000-4.200 dolar bandında hareket ediyor.

news.titleTr: EU taps industry to set standards for tokenized securities
news.summaryTr: Applications close Nov. 27 for an industry group that aims to draft initial standards for holding and settling tokenized securities by early 2028.
news.articleText: EU taps industry to set standards for tokenized securities Applications close Nov. 27 for an industry group that aims to draft initial standards for holding and settling tokenized securities by early 2028. The European Central Bank, European Commission and European Securities and Markets Authority are seeking nominations for an industry-led group that will draft common standards for holding and settling tokenized securities. Eligible applicants include EU industry associations, global institutions, private firms and fintech companies. They can apply to the European Tokenisation Standards Group (ETSG) by Nov. 27, with work set to begin in January 2027, according to a release published Monday. The three EU institutions will participate as observers. The group will develop technical and market standards to help companies hold and settle tokenized securities across different distributed ledger technology (DLT) platforms and ensure those platforms can work with existing financial systems. The group aims to produce an initial set of standards by early 2028, according to its mandate. The standards will support Appia, the Eurosystem’s initiative to develop a blueprint for Europe’s tokenized financial markets. The institutions warned that fragmentation could limit the benefits of tokenization and said the group may recommend ways for EU authorities to encourage firms to adopt its standards. In September, the Eurosystem launched Pontes, a system that allows financial institutions to settle wholesale transactions in tokenized assets in central bank money. Related: ECB President Christine Lagarde to step down in February 2027

news.summary: New petrol or diesel cars are due to be phased out by 2030 and by 2035 all new cars must be zero emission.

news.titleTr: Government's EV targets expected to be reduced this week
news.summaryTr: New petrol or diesel cars are due to be phased out by 2030 and by 2035 all new cars must be zero emission.
news.articleText: Government's EV targets expected to be reduced this week - Published The UK government's electric vehicle (EV) targets are expected to be reduced this week in a move likely to be welcomed by carmakers but opposed by environmental groups. Under the current rules, 80% of new cars sold in the UK must be electric by 2030 but industry groups have long called for "urgent relief". New petrol or diesel cars are due to be phased out by 2030 and by 2035 all new cars must be zero emission. But the speed of the transition to electric has been hotly debated, including within the cabinet. The government has been consulting on reducing its 80% rule and a significant reduction is now expected. Downing Street has insisted no decision has been made. A government source told the BBC it would approach the issue in a "pragmatic and balanced" way. If ministers do decide on a steeper watering-down of the rules, it will arguably be interpreted by some - alongside the approval of the Jackdaw gas field in the North Sea - as the government prioritising economic considerations over environmental ones. Prime Minister Andy Burnham has recused himself from this issue due to his wife's links to an electric vehicle company. The key meetings on the subject will instead be chaired by Cabinet Office minister Louise Haigh. Asked about reports the targets would be reduced, Burnham dismissed this as "speculation", adding: "No decision has been made at this point." Sustainability groups say any weakening of the 2030 target will threaten the UK's long-term electrification and climate goals. It could undermine the UK's claim to be providing leadership on climate just as ministers head to Turkey for COP31, the UN's climate summit. Energy UK, the trade association for the energy industry, has also opposed the move. Last month, it said, external reducing targets could damage "the investment certainty needed to deliver the infrastructure, innovation and services required for the transition to zero-emission transport". Asked if climate change was no longer a big priority, Health Minister Karin Smyth said the government was committed to its emissions targets. "This country is doing great work in terms of our transition and looking at renewables – that's a key part of growth in different parts of the country," she told BBC Breakfast. She added that the prime minister would have "a good story to tell" when meeting other leaders at COP31. A government spokesperson said: "We are committed to the phase out of all new cars relying solely on petrol and diesel engines by 2030, and to 100% of new car and van sales being zero emission by 2035, and our legally binding net zero targets." The Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders welcomed the government's review of the EV targets when it was announced in the summer. Last week, head of the association Mike Hawes said transitioning to electric vehicles had come at a "heavy cost" with billions spent on discounts to drive demand in electric vehicles. He said the government's targets could not be achieved "without putting at risk any future investment". - UK electric car sales target set to be weakened - Published14 June - EU waters down plans to end new petrol and diesel car sales by 2035 - Published16 December 2025 Net zero means balancing the amount of planet-warming "greenhouse" gases produced by human activities with the amount being actively removed from the atmosphere. The government's policy to phase out petrol and diesel vehicle sales has undergone multiple changes since it was first introduced by former Prime Minister Boris Johnson in 2020. His successor Rishi Sunak pushed back the timeline to 2035, and the Burnham government set up a review of the EV sales targets in August. Sunak introduced phased targets for EV sales in the UK, known as the Zero Emission Vehicles (ZEV) mandate. Under the ZEV mandate, the percentage of new car sales that need to be EVs increases each year. The target was 28% for 2025, 33% for 2026, and so on until it reaches 80% by 2030. Pressure in the European Union saw the bloc scrap a similar plan to ban new petrol and diesel car sales by 2035, particularly from countries with large auto industries such as Germany. The Conservative Party has also vowed to abandon the petrol car ban if it wins the next election, with leader Kemi Badenoch calling it a "well-meaning, but ultimately destructive piece of legislation". Green Party leader Zack Polanski said the government was "building up a shocking record of backsliding and bad decisions on climate issues". news.title: Krakow shooting suspect has died in hospital, police say
news.summary: Six people were killed in the shooting, and three bodies of the suspect's family members were found at their home.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Krakow shooting suspect has died in hospital, police say
news.summaryTr: Six people were killed in the shooting, and three bodies of the suspect's family members were found at their home.
news.articleText: Krakow shooting suspect has died in hospital, police say - Published A gunman suspected of killing six people in central Krakow and his parents and sister at their home has died in hospital, Polish police say. The 24-year-old was injured after opening fire in central Krakow, the second largest city in Poland, on Saturday, and died early on Monday morning, police said. Armed officers raced to the scene and engaged in a gunfight with the suspect, who was shot within three minutes of the attack beginning, preventing a further massacre, officials said. Officials initially reported the gunman had apparently been inspired by "far-right ideologies", but have since said they are still investigating any possible motivation. After the shooting, which began shortly before 15:00 local time (14:00 GMT) in Krakow's busy Main Market Square, police identified the attacker as a 24-year-old Polish man. He has not yet been officially named. In the hours after the shooting, a minister said early investigations indicate he was inspired by "far-right ideologies". The minister also described him as an "ultra-nationalist" without giving further details. However, during a press briefing on Monday morning, Przemysław Nowak, a spokesperson for Poland's National Prosecutor's Office, said investigations into his motive remain ongoing. Six people - four women and two men - are confirmed to have been killed in the attack. Four victims are Polish, while a British national and an Austrian woman were also killed. Poland's Prime Minister Donald Tusk said three bodies - two women and one man - were found at the gunman's house when it was searched after the attack. On Sunday, Polish police confirmed those three victims had been identified as the alleged gunman's 53-year-old father, 52-year-old mother and 21-year-old sister. Polish media has reported the suspect had a firearms permit and may have obtained the weapons from his family home. Four firearms were found in the gunman's car, including two AR-15 rifles and two handguns, along with several hundred rounds of ammunition, Nowak said. Authorities also seized at least four phones from his car and person, and electronic equipment from his home. Sixteen people, including five foreigners, two police officers and the attacker, were taken to hospital. The interior ministry later said they were from Austria, Britain, Germany, Portugal and Russia. Speaking on Sunday, one of two surgeons who treated victims on the street after the attack said his colleague "undoubtedly" saved the life of a gravely injured police officer. The two surgeons, who were eating near the Main Market Square when the gunman opened fire, rushed to the scene to treat both the attacker and the two injured police officers. Professor Michal Pędziwiatr told the BBC: "We saw the shooting attack. And what a surgeon can do in a situation like this?... We decided to help the victims as soon as possible." "We rushed into the area where the shooting was and started our rescue, because there were no ambulances available, there were no professionals around." Pędziwiatr said his colleague, who has been named by local media as Dr Mateusz Wierdak, used his hand to stem the bleeding from the most severely injured policeman, allowing time for an ambulance to arrive. On Sunday it was reported that both injured officers had emerged from comas. Witnesses who were near the Main Market Square have described their panic and confusion as the attack unfolded. Ruby Catherine Warren, from London, heard gunfire and "yelled at my friends to run and we all sprinted for our lives". She said they "just kept sprinting" until they found a hotel to shelter inside. Tom Brook, from West Yorkshire, was inside a McDonald's near the square when he heard "multiple gunshots and saw people running for cover". "I then walked into the square and saw paramedics working on someone outside [a shop] and there was a dead body covered in foil blankets 20 meters away," he said. In the wake of the shooting, Poland declared the country would enter two days of national mourning. After travelling to Krakow, Tusk said: "Until now in Poland we haven't had such drastic cases of terrorism...that's what we have to call this cruel attack on people's lives here in Krakow." UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham said he was "shocked and saddened by the appalling shooting in Kraków". "My thoughts are with the families of those who have lost their lives, everyone injured and all those affected by this senseless violence. The United Kingdom stands in solidarity with the people of Poland," he added. Main Market Square reopened on Sunday evening after a security cordon was lifted. news.summary: Coinbase plans to expand its institutional crypto custody business under the federal charter and is exploring digital asset payment products.

news.titleTr: Coinbase’s US national trust bank charter takes effect
news.summaryTr: Coinbase plans to expand its institutional crypto custody business under the federal charter and is exploring digital asset payment products.
news.articleText: Coinbase’s US national trust bank charter takes effect Coinbase plans to expand its institutional crypto custody business under the federal charter and is exploring digital asset payment products. Coinbase’s national trust bank charter took effect on Friday, according to the US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC). The applied for the charter in October 2025 and received preliminary approval in April 2026, according to the OCC’s filing record. The charter allows Coinbase National Trust Company to hold digital assets on behalf of clients as a fiduciary, according to the OCC’s preliminary approval letter. Coinbase plans to offer institutional clients segregated custody accounts, with access to staking, financing and trading through other Coinbase entities, according to its charter application. Coinbase’s application also outlined plans to explore digital asset payment products and custody services that would allow clients to interact with select smart contracts. Other crypto companies that received OCC national trust bank charters include Ripple, Circle, BitGo, Fidelity Digital Assets and Paxos. Crypto.com and Stripe-owned Bridge received conditional approval, while Kraken and EDX Markets are still pursuing charters. Related: Hyperliquid Strategies seeks futures registration for perps

news.titleTr: Robinhood opens access to US IPOs for UK retail investors
news.summaryTr: Robinhood’s UK customers can request shares in eligible US initial public offerings at the offer price before the stocks begin trading.
news.articleText: Robinhood opens access to US IPOs for UK retail investors Robinhood’s UK customers can request shares in eligible US initial public offerings at the offer price before the stocks begin trading. Robinhood has launched a service that lets UK retail investors request shares in eligible US initial public offerings (IPOs) before trading begins. Customers can use their existing investment accounts to review offering documents in the app and request shares at the IPO price without paying trading commissions, Robinhood said Monday. Robinhood said it has participated in more than 50 IPOs since launching the service in the US in 2021. The company did not identify which upcoming US IPOs would be available to UK investors. Cointelegraph asked Robinhood for clarification but did not receive a response by publication. The expansion follows Robinhood’s third-quarter earnings report in October, when the company reported record revenue of $1.42 billion and net income of $476 million. Robinhood shares (HOOD) closed at $80.91 on Friday, gaining 3.2%, according to Yahoo Finance. The stock traded at $79.50 in premarket trading on Monday. Related: Robinhood’s Tenev warns US tokenization uncertainty deters ‘serious assets’

news.titleTr: At least 34 dead after Europe-bound migrant boat sinks off Senegal
news.summaryTr: The Atlantic crossing to Spain's Canary Islands remains dangerous for migrants seeking a better life
news.articleText: At least 34 dead after Europe-bound migrant boat sinks off Senegal - Published At least 34 people have died after a boat carrying migrants sank off the coast of Senegal, the Senegalese Press Agency (APS) reports, citing an official source. The interior ministry said one person had been rescued, but the number of people still missing was yet to be established. The small wooden boat capsized between the capital, Dakar and the northern city of Saint-Louis, as it headed towards Spain's Canary Islands. Spanish migrant rights group Walking Borders recorded 635 deaths on the Atlantic route to the Canary Islands between January and May 2026, the highest toll among the routes it monitors. Saliou Diouf, founder of Senegalese migrant aid group Boza Fii, told AFP that all the bodies recovered so far were Senegalese. The nationalities of other people on board was yet to be established, as search operations continued. President Bassirou Diomaye Faye has expressed his condolences to the victims' families and urged Senegalese nationals not risk their lives on the dangerous sea crossings. In a statement posted on X, he pledged to intensify efforts to dismantle the networks organising the journeys. "We will relentlessly continue the fight against those who organise these crossings and the work that gives our young people reasons to hope here," he said. The tragedy comes amid renewed concerns over the dangers facing migrant attempting to reach Europe by sea. Walking Borders estimates that about 21 people died for every 100 who reached the Canary Islands during the period it monitored. news.titleTr: Four killed in Gaza after sand embankment collapses onto tents, health ministry says
news.summaryTr: Three children are among those killed in the incident that came a day after heavy rain reportedly flooded tens of thousands of tents across Gaza.
news.articleText: Four killed in Gaza after sand embankment collapses onto tents, health ministry says - Published Three children and one woman were killed when a sand embankment collapsed onto tents in central Gaza following heavy rain, the Hamas-run health ministry says. Five injured people were also reportedly rescued after the incident on Sunday night at a camp for displaced families south of Deir al-Balah. Videos showed men using phone torches to search for survivors beneath boulders, sand and collapsed tents. The Civil Defence service, which operates under the Hamas-run interior ministry, said the "humanitarian tragedy" should prompt urgent action by international organisations to provide safe shelters for displaced people and move tents away from sandy areas, slopes and locations at risk of collapse. Torrential rain on Saturday reportedly flooded tens of thousands of tents across Gaza, leaving many Palestinians without a dry place to sleep. The Civil Defence said water levels reached up to 1.5m (4.9ft) in some places and that its first responders were able to respond to only 10% of the 2,100 distress calls they received. "Protecting the lives of displaced people is an urgent humanitarian responsibility. Their tents must not become death traps beneath sand and rainwater," it warned. - Tens of thousands of tents flooded after heavy rains in Gaza - Published1 day ago - Funding shortages force World Food Programme to cut Gaza aid - Published20 October The Civil Defence initially reported on Sunday that three children and two women were killed when the sand embankment collapsed. But the health ministry said on Monday morning that only one woman was among the dead. She was identified as Tahrir Nabhan, while the children were named as Mariam Nabhan and her brother Salah, and Habiba al-Zein. Mustafa al-Masri told the BBC that he and other rescuers had used their bare hands to dig the victims and survivors out of the sand and rubble. "It was extremely difficult. This mound was huge and wide. It collapsed onto the tent, and we didn't know what to do," he said. "When we got here, we, along with the young men from the camp, pulled them out with our own hands. We pulled out the children and the woman." "Their father arrived shouting, 'My children, my children, my children, my children.' We pulled his children out, put them in the ambulance, and took them to the hospital." Masri added that he had been displaced from the northern town of Beit Hanoun but had stayed in central Gaza because there was "nowhere for me to return to". "We went out looking around, searching through the open areas and hills, but I couldn't find any place other than this area that felt suitable for me." The International Organization for Migration's regional crisis co-ordinator, Karl Baker, told the BBC from Gaza that the territory's 2.1 million population was confined to only 30% of its total area and that many people were "unfortunately living in areas which would not be normal if we were not in this time of conflict". He said the UN agency and its partners were trying to make sure there were enough tents and tarpaulins, as well as improved drainage in camps, to help them get through the winter. However, he warned that aid currently getting into Gaza was not sufficient to meet the demands of the population, describing it as "the very smallest of Band-Aids [plasters]". "We need more support, in-kind donations. We need funding in order to help the communities to help themselves," he said. "We need a lot more to happen." UN agencies have called on Israeli authorities to allow in the specialist equipment and materials required to improve living conditions for displaced families. Cogat, the Israeli military body tasked with co-ordinating deliveries, said on Sunday that more than 91,000 tents, 12 vacuum trucks for waste removal, and fuel and engine oil for pumping facilities have been delivered since the start of the "Gaza Winterization Plan". But it added that Israel would not permit the entry of equipment that could be used for military purposes by Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups. An estimated 80% of all structures in Gaza have been destroyed or damaged during the war between Israel and Hamas, according to the UN. More than 1.9 million people have been displaced, many of them multiple times, and 1.2 million of them are currently living in tents or makeshift shelters, it says. The UN has warned that the humanitarian situation in Gaza remains dire despite the ceasefire agreed in October 2025, as Israeli air strikes and other attacks continue to hit populated areas, causing casualties and property damage and driving further displacement. The Gaza war was triggered by the Hamas-led attack on southern Israel on 7 October 2023, when about 1,200 people were killed and 251 others were taken hostage. Since then, more than 74,640 people have been killed in Gaza, according to the territory's health ministry, whose figures are considered reliable by the UN. Additional reporting by Malak Hassouneh

news.titleTr: Trump says he was 'kidding' about Dana White press secretary offer
news.summaryTr: The president told the Ultimate Fighting Championship boss to "please take the job" in a Truth Social post on Saturday.
news.articleText: Trump says he was 'kidding' about Dana White press secretary offer - Published US President Donald Trump has said he "was kidding" about asking Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) boss Dana White to be the White House press secretary. Trump told the media on Sunday that White "loves the idea" but that the invitation was "just a little fun". It comes after the president posted on his Truth Social platform on Saturday that he had offered White the role, asking him to take it while writing, "Dana will be a Press Secretary like none other." White said later that day he was going to meet the president on Monday, but would not be drawn into whether or not he would take the vacant position. On Sunday Trump told reporters White was visiting him on Monday for "other reasons". "I think he's going to be in Washington. So he's going to come over and see me. "I will tell you, I was only kidding. But Dana loves the idea. And there's only one Dana. He's great," the president said. "But, it was it was just a little fun." The press secretary role is yet to be filled after it became vacant in October when Katie Zacharia quit after less than five days in the job. She took over from Karoline Leavitt, who was the youngest press secretary in US history and had held the role since Trump began his second term. Trump's job offer came after a heavy loss in the midterm elections, where the Republican Party lost its majority in both houses of Congress. In his Truth Social post on Saturday, he said he was "pleased to announce" that White "has been offered the job". He said he had asked White to bring with him several current and former mixed martial arts fighters as "assistants". "We need these people to defend us against the Lunatic Left," he wrote. "Dana, please take the job!" Asked about the Trump offer at a news conference on Saturday, the UFC chief executive said he had "lot of jobs already". "I'm sure we'll have something to talk about after that," he said of their planned Monday meeting, but did not say whether or not he would take the job. White leads UFC, and PowerSlap, a regulated slap-fighting promotion league, as well as recently launching promotion company Zuffa Boxing. He is also a board member of Meta, the owner of Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp. White appeared as a speaker in support of Trump's White House campaigns at the Republican National Conventions in 2016, 2020 and 2024. He also appeared on stage for Trump's victory speech in the 2024 presidential election. This summer, the UFC staged a cage match on the White House lawn.

news.title: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's affair with suspected Chinese spy
news.summary: Jensen Huang also admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and says he will cooperate with a security investigation.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's affair with suspected Chinese spy
news.summaryTr: Jensen Huang also admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and says he will cooperate with a security investigation.
news.articleText: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's affair with suspected Chinese spy - Published US tech giant Nvidia has opened an independent investigation following reports its CEO Jensen Huang had a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. Nvidia, one of the most valuable companies in the world, said its board had no reason to believe the company's secrets or national security were compromised, adding that the CEO was committed to continuing to lead the organisation. Separately, Jensen Huang admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. US intelligence officials believed that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report., external Jensen Huang said he took "full responsibility" for what he did, adding that he had fallen short of his responsibilities to Nvidia's employees, board and shareholders. Nvidia is one of the world's largest companies and seen as central to making the hardware for emerging AI technologies, and Jensen Huang has been in charge of it for more than 30 years. He said: "I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry." His statement continued: "Regarding the national security concerns raised in news reports, Nvidia's Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation. I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. "I love our country and our company. I am committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America's national security. I am proud and grateful to be an American." A separate statement issued by Nvidia's board of directors said it would begin an investigation in "light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort". It continued: "The Board prioritises US national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of Nvidia and its shareholders. "While the Board has no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, the Board's inquiry will examine all available information." US President Donald Trump said he had not spoken to the Nvidia boss since news of the investigation emerged. "I just know he's a fine person, but you never know what's going on," Trump told reporters, adding that he had "done an amazing job for our country". The New York Times reported in late October that Trump had been briefed last year on intelligence alleging Alice Huang was spying on China's behalf. Asked by reporters on Sunday whether he now wished he had "acted on the intelligence" at the time, Trump responded: "No, I don't think so. I think he's an honourable guy." Secretary of State Marco Rubio, meanwhile, refused to comment when asked about Huang before flying to Paris for a meeting of the G7. Rubio told the press: "I can't comment on any of that. I just can't comment because of the nature of it. And I also can't comment on an internal corporate matter that's going on with Nvidia, as you highlight, I don't know anything about that part of it so." Last spring, the secretary of state reportedly oversaw the drafting of a memo that warned the Trump administration about Huang's relationship with the Chinese businesswoman, according to the New York Times. China has previously rejected allegations of an espionage operation targeting the Nvidia chief, describing the claims as "groundless speculation". Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun told reporters at a daily press briefing: "We have already responded to this. The allegations about Chinese spies are entirely groundless, speculative and intended to smear and malign China." Jensen Huang rescued Nvidia from bankruptcy on more than one occasion, and he took risks on AI a long time before the rest of the world did. His decision to make Nvidia chips, originally designed for gaming, become the best in the business for AI development, has now paid off in spades and the company is worth trillions. This is a big blow for a man who is renowned for being a workaholic, a perfectionist and someone who expects incredibly high standards from his staff. Alice Huang, who is of no relation to Jensen Huang, is linked to Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed. The company told the New York Times last month its current leadership took the allegations seriously and had appointed external legal advisers to conduct an internal investigation. Nvidia is a central player in AI infrastructure, providing chips to leading AI model developers including OpenAI and Meta. The microchip manufacturer is worth some $4.5 trillion, making it one of the most valuable companies ever. US intelligence agencies had been monitoring Alice Huang and concluded that she was acting on behalf of the Chinese government, according to unnamed sources cited by the New York Times. Surveillance reportedly revealed communications between Alice Huang and an American citizen, who was subsequently identified as Jensen Huang through a process known as "unmasking". It remains unclear what information Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly passed to Beijing, how valuable it was, or when she is believed to have begun gathering intelligence. Alice Huang did not respond to the paper's request for comment. Last week, members of Congress wrote to Jensen Huang, asking him to appear before them in the light of the reported relationship. Three House Republican committee leaders asked the CEO to appear later in the month, to talk about Nvidia's "security protocols against foreign adversary espionage" given his reported relationship with Alice Huang. "Recent reports raise significant national security concerns regarding the PRC's [China's] access to sensitive US technology and information. "The issue of PRC infiltration and access to cutting-edge US technology is core to the investigative work of our three committees this Congress," the letter said. Nvidia's AI chips have been a major focus of the rivalry between the US and China, and Washington has previously imposed controls on where its advanced products can be sold. The H200, Nvidia's second most advanced semiconductor, had previously been restricted by Washington over concerns that it would give China's technology industry an edge over the US. In January, the Trump administration said it would allow the company to sell its H200 chips to Chinese customers under certain conditions. This is a big blow for a man who is renowned for being a workaholic, a perfectionist and someone who expects incredibly high standards from his staff. Alice Huang, who is of no relation to Jensen Huang, is linked to Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed. The company told the New York Times last month its current leadership took the allegations seriously and had appointed external legal advisers to conduct an internal investigation. Nvidia is a central player in AI infrastructure, providing chips to leading AI model developers including OpenAI and Meta. The microchip manufacturer is worth some $4.5 trillion, making it one of the most valuable companies ever. US intelligence agencies had been monitoring Alice Huang and concluded that she was acting on behalf of the Chinese government, according to unnamed sources cited by the New York Times. Surveillance reportedly revealed communications between Alice Huang and an American citizen, who was subsequently identified as Jensen Huang through a process known as "unmasking". It remains unclear what information Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly passed to Beijing, how valuable it was, or when she is believed to have begun gathering intelligence. Alice Huang did not respond to the paper's request for comment. Last week, members of Congress wrote to Jensen Huang, asking him to appear before them in the light of the reported relationship. Three House Republican committee leaders asked the CEO to appear later in the month, to talk about Nvidia's "security protocols against foreign adversary espionage" given his reported relationship with Alice Huang. "Recent reports raise significant national security concerns regarding the PRC's [China's] access to sensitive US technology and information. "The issue of PRC infiltration and access to cutting-edge US technology is core to the investigative work of our three committees this Congress," the letter said. Nvidia's AI chips have been a major focus of the rivalry between the US and China, and Washington has previously imposed controls on where its advanced products can be sold. The H200, Nvidia's second most advanced semiconductor, had previously been restricted by Washington over concerns that it would give China's technology industry an edge over the US. In January, the Trump administration said it would allow the company to sell its H200 chips to Chinese customers under certain conditions. news.summary: The man has lived in the self-built hut since 2020 - but never told authorities or asked for permission.

news.titleTr: Hut owner wins battle to keep living in off-grid home he built
news.summaryTr: The man has lived in the self-built hut since 2020 - but never told authorities or asked for permission.
news.articleText: Hut owner wins battle to keep living in off-grid home he built - Published An off-grid hut that produces its own heating and electricity can continue to be the home of the man who built it, a council has decided. Geoffrey Finnimore, a self-employed architectural designer, erected the structure in Glandwr, near Crymych, in 2020, but never told authorities or asked for permission. Pembrokeshire council told him he must apply for retrospective permission for the home that is self-sufficient, and also collects rain water. However, the local authority found that because it has now been occupied as a home for more than four years, it is immune from prosecution action. "Without my home, which I created to solve my own problems and without state assistance, having to pay for other accommodation would be catastrophic for my finances and wellbeing," Finnimore said. The council asked him to apply for a lawful development certificate, external for the property. This is a formal legal document confirming the development is lawful. But as he had lived there for more than four years, it meant he could not be prosecuted, so his application was accepted, the Local Democracy Reporting Service said. Finnimore has been the principal custodian of 4.5 acres of land at Coed Troednoeth, Tir y Gafel since the previous owner left in 2018. They had lived at the site in a campervan with a lean-to structure, according to the council. But Finnimore described this as "less than adequate" for his health and wellbeing, so started developing the hut. In a personal statement to the local authority, he confirmed he had lived at the site for more than 10 years, earns less than £10,000 a year as a self-employed worker, and provided evidence of his long-term residency. He added: "This application has been sought by the council, and I have had to comply out of a position of vulnerability with respect to the prospect of enforcement against a building and living situation that has been demonstrated to be well-established and that I hold is deemed lawful. "In the context of a housing and a cost-of-living crisis I have taken care of my own needs. "So far as the council's responsibilities in that context goes, I see that as one less problem to solve. "Conversely, I would consider a rejection of a well-justified application like this as a contribution that exacerbates these deep and present social concerns." Council officers granted the certificate because they found, on the balance of probabilities, that Coed Troednoeth had existed and been occupied as a home for more than four years before the application, making it immune from enforcement action. It added: "In June 2020, the land was purchased by Mr Finnimore and in November 2020, he began using the building as his principal dwelling, hence the justification to apply for a certificate of lawful use." news.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-
